notes.title: V. 3.87
notes.content:
[b]Added level 66[/b]

Level 66 is a huge walk-in aquarium, and is composed of a dark pipe maze. There's a bit of light coming in from the outside, but for the most part level 66 is pitch-black with an ominous blue fog in the background. You can exit to level 41 via an "Emergency Exit" door, and you can enter through a similar door in level 44. Requested by @Ali666 on our discord server.

[b]Added a new entity: The Anethika[/b]

This tall, lanky, black creature resides in level 66, but will be put in other levels soon. The Anethika is rather strong and fast, making it quite difficult to kill. It's one of the stronger enemies in all of BrVR.

[b]Added back the Mapping Device[/b]

Back in the early days, you were able to purchase a mapping device (jokingly we called it a Clumpass, because it acted like a compass and you could buy it from Clump Power INC). This is now back in the form of a crafted item.

[b]Added The Industrial Crafter[/b]

The industrial crafter is now here, allowing you to turn basic parts into more complex industrial parts like motors, valves, and connectors. These industrial parts can be crafted into one of eight (more coming soon) different high-tech items. You can operate it by putting items in the center and clicking "craft together" to combine the items. Another capability of the industrial crafter is the ability to bottle liquids that are in cylinders, allowing them to be used in Squirt Guns. For convenience, there's another panel on the industrial crafter which allows you to spawn resources that you have in your crafting inventory and store higher-tier industrial parts for later use.

[b]Improved the Level 188 Preview[/b]

The 188 preview is nearly finished. There are a number of good changes that have been made, although the elevators are still broken for the time being.

Here are some rapid-fire changes:

[b]Adjusted the hedge maze graphics - Requested by @Ali666 on our discord server
Fixed a gap in the tutorial geometry
Improved The Clump Inside Viewer
Improved Bouncy House Material
Lit the level FUN arena a bit more - Requested By @LunanightZ on our discord server[/b]

Join our discord https://discord.gg/rAhVHZnUuJ

notes.title: V. 3.83
notes.content:
This is a fun update: We have a revamp, a new level, and a level preview all in one. Here they are:

[b]Revamped level 39[/b]

Level 39 has gotten a complete facelift. It's now much smaller, however that means that it looks much better and is significantly more optimized. There are now wild hounds and two exits instead of just one. New ambience is present as well.

[b]Added Level 130[/b]

Level 130 is a new procedurally-generated level which takes the form of an infinite labyrinth of pools. There are several different types of hallways that can generate, and even some rooms with random loot. There aren't any entities (the wiki called for dullers but they're difficult to do on procedural levels) so you can explore freely to your heart's content.

[b]Added Level Negative 4 Preview[/b]

A new preview for Level Negative 4 has been added. It is significantly more built out than the previous version, but as of now it's very laggy and the lighting isn't very good. Those issues will be ironed out soon. Remember, you can access level previews by going to the hub, to the legacy museum, then to the test map and looking behind you.

Here are some rapid-fire changes:

[b]Worked more on the bolt interation for the mk3 rifle
Made a couple of new airhorn reactions
Improved M1 Garand and M1A hand-holds
Added some particles to the PoolroomsSand exit
[/b]

notes.title: V. 3.81, "Rampage Update"
notes.content:
[b]Added the Rampage Vinyl[/b]

A new 12-track compilation album is out featuring tracks from LunaNightZ, Bucket Of Chicken, and myself. Dubbed "Rampage Compilation" in-game, it has a large focus on heavier rock, industrial, and metal. You can buy it at the LunaNightZ record store and get a cassette as well for portability.

[b]Added several new Arena Mode features[/b]

If you're in Arena Mode, you can play the aforementioned rampage record without spending any backrooms bucks. However, that's far from the only change. There's now a power-up that drops from enemies infrequently. It doubles your damage, but decreases your health slightly for around 30 seconds. It even gets its own theme when active! Secondly, there are new, bigger versions of enemies that can spawn rarely. They're much more difficult to take down, as they have 3-4x the amount of health of the normal ones.

[b]Added Firesalt Pistol[/b]

This 5-shot fire-shooting pistol is currently only available in arena mode but will be made available to the rest of the backrooms sometime soon. Suggested by @FrankC on our discord

[b]Added MEG Faction Status[/b]

Guards now adorn the MEG bases alpha and omega, and if you do something bad (shooting inside the base) the MEG won't like you very much. Good luck trying to walk into a MEG base after that, you'll get instantly recognized. In addition, new MEG soldiers will attempt to hunt you down if you're still inside the base when the alarm is going off. To equalize this, I made detection of threats to the MEG much more lenient. A system to buy another identity will be added, allowing you to re-enter the MEG bases if you'd like to stay on the straight and narrow.

[b]Added level 75 preview[/b]

Level 75 is a new cave level that has rising and falling liquid metal in the pits. This metal is extremely difficult to swim through and will suffocate you if your head goes under, so watch out! Only run when the "tide" is down, and keep a close eye on which direction it's headed. The reason this is a preview is that there's still relatively little to do in the level, and the collision for some of the rocks is beyond horrendous. You can try to find the exit though, if you see orange rocks, you know you're on the right track.

[b]Improved level 188 preview[/b]

Many new walls and text actors have been replaced. Lights have been added to the bottom-most halls, and many cracks into the void have been sealed (with a quantum trowel of seal flex). The ambience has also been worked on. It's a slow process but this version

notes.title: V. 3.80 MAIN BRANCH UPDATE
notes.content:
[h1]This update is back on the main branch! If you are on the beta branch, you will also be updated to this version automatically.[/h1]

[b]"Frutigerized" most all of the UI[/b]

The UI for the menu, vault, crafting bench, upgrade bench, crafting material selling bench, and arena mode spawn panel have all been revamped with new colors, fonts, and icons. We took a poll as to the style, and the winning style was Frutiger Aero. There are also new UI sounds to accompany the visual overhaul.

[b]Added level 188 preview[/b]

Starting in April of last year, we have been working on a revamp for level 188. There have been a number of difficulties in getting it in, but now a preview is in. Somehow all of the text and walls got lost in translation somewhere and I'm having to put them all back, one by one. The preview is extremely broken and laggy, but if you'd really like to try it out, you can go to the legacy museum in the hub, go to the "aim" map, and then enter the door behind spawn.

[b]Added a broken door mechanic[/b]

You can now fix No-clip-a-matic doors for the MEG. Go to MEG base alpha to apply. There's a television behind the main room that allows you to see which doors need fixing, although after you've applied you can see those at any time inside the notebook. To fix a door, walk up to it (you'll know it's the correct one if it says "BRKN" in place of a level name), approach the right side, turn off the electricity so you don't electrocute yourself, press the correct calibration buttons until the green bar is at 100%, then turn back on electricity. You'll get 650$ for each door fixed.

A couple of rapid-fire changes:

[b]Added new tutorials to the UI of the crafting bench and upgrade bench[/b]
[b]Added more trims to level 5 and the casino[/b]

Now, if you were on the main branch you'll get a ton of other stuff from past beta updates. Unlike the last ones, I will not list those changes here for the sake of keeping the post short. However, if you'd like to know, scroll down to get the patch notes for the last beta updates.

notes.title: V. 3.79
notes.content:
[b]Added the all object launcher (and variants)[/b]

A fun little thing that had my attention for longer than it should've. Essentially, it's an upgrade to the balloonderbuss that allows you to launch any object. There are 4 variants: Standard, sniper, high-capacity, and expanded. Standard and sniper both have a capacity of 1, but high-capacity and expanded have capacities of 5 and 15 respectively. The sniper variant has sights affixed to the launcher and the expanded variant has a pistol grip, making them easier to use. To use the launchers, pick up an object (anything, try magazines first) and shove them in the front. Then press A/X to prime the hammer and press trigger to launch it. You can hold down A/X to forcibly discharge everything inside of the launcher, which isn't very useful but sure is fun.

[b]Added the welding tool[/b]

A very fun but potentially janky tool for sandbox gameplay. It's only available via the test map for now but will be added to the sandbox map soon. It's what it sounds like, a tool that attaches two objects together.

[b]Made some changes to the backpack[/b]

The backpack now freezes in place instead of getting sucked back onto your back once let go. There are also some smaller collision changes but there will be more changes in the future!

[b]Worked on grenade physics[/b]

Grenades now have less of a tendency to freeze, but are still being worked on.

[b]Fixed a bug with level 19...whoops[/b]

Level 19 was broken on the beta branch until today...whoops

[b]Added the time slow on entity damage option[/b]

This option slows time when an entity is damaged, and is a great option for backrooms filmmakers. It resumes normal time after a couple of seconds.

[b]Improved the lottery tickets[/b]

The lottery tickets now have three fields that act similar to a slot machine, plus a new "bonus cash" scratch at the bottom which worked similar to the original lottery.

A couple of rapid-fire features:

[b]Added many new rooms to level 4
Casino chris now can't win at his own slot machine
Added new options to the analog horror filter[/b]

notes.title: V. 3.77
notes.content:
New this week: Infinite level 0, more. This is a BETA update. Please use the Beta branch in BrVR's steam library page -> gear icon -> properties -> betas.

[b]Revamped Procedural Level 0[/b]

Procedural Level 0 has been completely revamped with overhauled graphics, many new rooms (and variants), new entity spawns, and a new biome (pitfalls). All walls in the main biome now have trims, making it look much more complete. It now runs at a consistent FPS as well.

There are a few known issues with the generation: Carpet disconnected from pitfall walls, flashlights inoperative near red light areas, and an issue with trims in the 0.2 biome. These have already been fixed, but I didn't have enough time to re-build the packaged game so that I could give y'all the fixed version. They're minor issues so they shouldn't effect gameplay too much.

Now for some rapid-fire changes:

[b]Made it so that sanity doesn't have any effect in level 11
Added the less red filter
Added an upgrade recipe for the M82
Added slots for weapons to the bottom two slots of the gun rack
Added shopping cart collision sounds
Resized some of the skin-stealers in the factory
Moved the level 11 start back to the normal location
Fixed an issue with chips in your ammo pouch triggering casino equipment

notes.title: V. 3.73
notes.content:
New this week: New upgrade system, bug fixes, QOL changes. This is a BETA update. Please use the Beta branch in BrVR's steam library page -> gear icon -> properties -> betas.

[b]Overhauled the entire upgrades system[/b]

The upgrade bench now has a completely different UI. Putting an item on the bench will initiate the UI to change, showing what item you have and the available upgrades. Items can have up to three available upgrades. You can then click on an upgrade to apply the upgrade to the item on the table, if you have the required item listed also on the table (if the required item is steel, it'll pull from your crafting inventory). This also makes it easier on the backend to add upgrade recipes, so expect more soon.

[b]Added more upgrade recipes to the .357 Revolver, AA12, PPSH, Balloon Gun, Thompson, Deagle, and Mac-11[/b]

All of the old recipes have remained, but some new ones have been added as well. First off, the .357 revolver can now be upgraded into the silenced variant sound in level -2. The AA12 can be upgraded into a longer barreled version or a version with a two-shot burst fire and reduced recoil, the PPSH can be upgraded to have extended magazines, the Balloon gun can be upgraded to be full auto, the thompson can be (down?)graded into the thock (more on that later), the deagle can be upgraded into a carbine, and the mac-11 can be upgraded into the mac-10.

[b]Added the Thock[/b]

You might have seen the Grompson vs Thock meme, and it's exactly what it sounds like, an upgrade from the Thompson that has the stock, sights, and most of the barrel removed.

[b]Added back extended magazines[/b]

The 1911, PPSH, and Mac-11 all now have an extended magazines upgrade option that gives them 15, 71, and 50 round mags respectively. This is similar to the old days where there was an extended magazines option in the settings menu.

notes.title: BIG OL' CHRISTMAS UPDATE!!!
notes.content:
[h1]This update is back on the main branch! If you are on the beta branch, you will also be updated to this version automatically.[/h1]

Well, it's here. Merry Christmas! I'm going to keep this short and just get into the changes. First, here are the non-gift changes. Gifts will be spoilered.

[b]Added The Gift Plane[/b]

If you'd like to open the gifts below, then you'll need to go to The Gift Plane. It can be accessed via a door in the level 11 convention center. It's a white snowy town area with a large Christmas tree, gifts, and a vault.

[b]Added a new arsenal for Arena Mode[/b]

The tables with guns on them have been replaced by one convenient kiosk. This made me realize how many weapons are in-game: There are over 60 entries on the list! And, that doesn't even count most melee weapons. This kiosk is divided into Shotguns, Pistols, Party Equipment, SMGs, Rifles, Grenade Launchers, and Exotic.

[b]Changed the inventory layout of pistols[/b]

Pistols now show up in your inventory facing down instead of backwards.

[spoiler][b]Added a LOT of items...[/b][/spoiler]

[spoiler]
Here's a full list, from left to right in The Gift Plane
Makarov Pocket Pistol: A pistol that will eventually replace the 1911 in most looting scenarios. The 1911 has been buffed.
Warpberries: Berries that warp you to level 10 once eaten

Mac-11 Red and Green skin: A Christmassy skin for the Mac-11
AK-47 Yellow Skin: A Wrap for the AK-47 made from a texture of leaves
AA-12 Shotgun: A way to waste buckshot efficiently. Suggested by @Cameraman on our discord

notes.title: V. 3.67
notes.content:
A big update today. New this week: Bowling, Attachment Saving, More. This is a BETA update. Please use the Beta branch in BrVR's steam library page -> gear icon -> properties -> betas.

[b]Adjusted Double Barrel Physics[/b]

You can now snap a double barreled shotgun closed via a hand gesture. In addition, the recoil is much improved from the last iteration.

[b]Disabled Friending in Arena Mode[/b]

Previously, arena mode could glitch out when an entity comes into contact with almond water and beef, causing the entity to go after every enemy on the map. This is fixed.

[b]Made Attachments Able To Be Taken Off Without Changing Levels (Wow, It Took You This Long)[/b]

You can cycle through the red dot, laser, scope, and blank attachment options now. Also, the delay between being able to cycle between them has decreased.

[b]Made Rail Attachments Save Across Levels [/b]

This is a pretty beta feature for now. It only works for items in your slots, not your hands (although that's coming soon) and doesn't include suppressors for the time being. Do you like suppressors? Me too. You can now get free infinite "janky" suppressors in the gun store for the time being.

[b]Added Clump Repellent[/b]

No, it's not an aerosol can. It's a special knife that can be used against clumps while they're pulling you in. Suggested by @ColtonsCats on our discord.

[b]Added Box Of Rattle-y Cans[/b]

Raging in level 2? Throw a can! Got slain by a skin-stealer in level 3? Shake a whole box of em around! These cans produce tons of noise and are great for getting all sorts of frustrations out. Suggested by @LunaNightZ on our discord.

[b]Holiday Event in Level 11[/b]

Level 11 has gotten a winter makeover for the time being. Snow is on the ground, there are new items to buy in the convention center, and there is a certain feeling of jolliness in the air.

[b]Updated Level 10 Arena Mode[/b]

Level 10 arena mode got a huge overhaul, receiving a complete graphical rework. It looks more like the new level 10 now with lush foliage and realistic-looking buildings.

[b]Added Level FUN Arena Mode[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/6e2633d32257801ad410e03a782e58862ee523d9.png[/img]

Level FUN arena mode has been added. This wide-open part of level fun features a dynamic environment to infinitely slay entities. There's even a fun little maze in the middle to lead entities through. Suggested by @ColtonsCats on our discord.

[b]Added the freeze gun utility[/b]

This new utility allows non-grabbed objects (for technical reasons sorry) to be frozen mid-air. Suggested by @SherlockBuzti on our discord.

[b]Added Santa hats to the Partygoers[/b]

As per the yearly tradition, Santa Hats are now on the Partygoers. This is the first time that the partygoer with the new animations has had a Santa Hat. There are also now buyable Santa Hats in the MEG Convention Center and limited edition Partygoer Santa Plushes too.

[b]Added a prototype physics demo for bowling[/b]

In level 40, you can follow a back hallway to a new bowling minigame. This is purely a physics test and the pins don't currently reset. If you get a strike, put it on our discord server. Fun fact: If you were to go here on the main branch, you would be met with a broken minigame where you could knock down almond waters with clumps. It's really pretty terrible. Here's a before-and-after:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/9b6bd074dacf25402eb5358cc244f0ee8ae4e6a0.png[/img]

Added bloody, gory skin-stealer deaths for head explosions
Adjusted Physics Sleeping On Vinyls[/b]

notes.title: V. 3.66
notes.content:
New this week:  New survival features and hard mode improvements. This is a BETA update. Please use the Beta branch in BrVR's steam library page -> gear icon -> properties -> betas.

[b]Added many new foods[/b]

Chocolate bars, Energy bars, Ramen, Cereal, Frozen Pizza, Orange Juice, Whiskey, Chips, and more foods have been added in this update. With new foods come new interactions: Chocolate bars and Energy bars must be opened before being eaten; Ramen must be opened, drenched with almond water, and cooked in the microwave before it can be eaten; Cereal and Chips must be opened before eating and they have a large quantity inside; And lastly, frozen pizza must be taken out of the box and cooked before it can be enjoyed. Whiskey and Orange Juice re-use old interactions.

[b]Added stoves and microwaves[/b]

Practically anywhere there's a residential microwave or stove in-game, it's been replaced by an useable version. If you find one that hasn't been replaced, let me know on the discord or in the steam forums. The microwave is rather simple: open the door, put in your food, close the door, and turn it on. The oven is more complex: you can either grab the center dial to turn on the stovetop, or open the door and turn on on the oven part itself. This is the only way to cook the pizza. Oddly enough, you can put the microwavable ramen in there, it just takes much longer to cook.

[b]Added level 296[/b]

Where should all of these new foods go? Level 296 is the answer. Written by our playtester Master Gamer and published to his wiki, it's a large grocery store with several different departments. The lights turn off after a while although no entities spawn since the level is Class 0. There are some special rooms like a maze of freezers, a room with a very high ceiling, and a loooong hallway full of aisles. There are many shopping carts throughout the level that you can push around and shop with.

[b]Balanced shotgun shells[/b]

Many changes have been made to shotguns that overall buff them. Here's a list of changes:

- Buckshot spread patterns for the 870 and Double Barrel shotguns have been standardized
- Buckshot does more damage
- Buckshot does even more damage up close, with a strong falloff. Although, it's possible to kill things from far away with it if you have a long enough barrel
- Barrel length of the 870s and Double Barrels effects spread. The sawn-off variants are very hard to use at over 15 yards or so
- Recoil has been altered on the double barrels to feel better, but it still isn't finished
- Slugs do less damage
- Buckshot and slugs now do extra headshot damage. If you're far out, aiming at the head is the best option

The M4, Gatekeeper (and variants), and other shotguns haven't been migrated over to use the new spread patterns for buckshot yet, but the damage changes still take effect.

[b]Made Mac-11 logic more realistic[/b]

Open bolt weapons are not capable of retaining a round in the chamber typically after the mag is dropped. This is now reflected as well as making it easier to operate slightly.

[b]Streamlined Skin-stealer Death[/b]

Skin-stealers flop over instantly instead of playing an animation and they also have a new death sound. This makes obliterating skin-stealers with the sawn-off shotgun VERY satisfying. More blood effects coming soon.

KNOWN BUGS: Cereal, chips, chocolate bars, energy bars, and cassette players can cause physics issues when put in the backpack. Most times, it should be OK though.

[b]Balanced shotgun shells[/b]

Many changes have been made to shotguns that overall buff them. Here's a list of changes:

- Buckshot spread patterns for the 870 and Double Barrel shotguns have been standardized
- Buckshot does more damage
- Buckshot does even more damage up close, with a strong falloff. Although, it's possible to kill things from far away with it if you have a long enough barrel
- Barrel length of the 870s and Double Barrels effects spread. The sawn-off variants are very hard to use at over 15 yards or so
- Recoil has been altered on the double barrels to feel better, but it still isn't finished
- Slugs do less damage
- Buckshot and slugs now do extra headshot damage. If you're far out, aiming at the head is the best option

The M4, Gatekeeper (and variants), and other shotguns haven't been migrated over to use the new spread patterns for buckshot yet, but the damage changes still take effect.

tags.feature:
[b]Made Mac-11 logic more realistic[/b]

Open bolt weapons are not capable of retaining a round in the chamber typically after the mag is dropped. This is now reflected as well as making it easier to operate slightly.

[b]Streamlined Skin-stealer Death[/b]

Skin-stealers flop over instantly instead of playing an animation and they also have a new death sound. This makes obliterating skin-stealers with the sawn-off shotgun VERY satisfying. More blood effects coming soon.

tags.bug: KNOWN BUGS: Cereal, chips, chocolate bars, energy bars, and cassette players can cause physics issues when put in the backpack. Most times, it should be OK though.

notes.content:
New this week:  New survival features and hard mode improvements. This is a BETA update. Please use the Beta branch in BrVR's steam library page -> gear icon -> properties -> betas.

[b]Added several survival features to hard mode[/b]

Covid-19 cases have been going down in the frontrooms, but apparently, a new disease has been rising in the backrooms! In Hard Mode, you can now get sick by eating raw meat or eating with bloody hands. Sickness makes you cough and take more damage, as well as have longer screen effects when damaged. You can disinfect yourself with a bottle of pills, found in tan crates. There is currently a known bug where pill jars can become empty when transferred between levels. Speaking of bloody hands, you can now get bloody hands by getting damaged in hard mode. Bloody hands can be washed off by pouring any liquid on your hands.

[b]Made it so that you can rob the level 33 ATMs[/b]

ATM robberies were never as simple! Just simply grab a crowbar (conveniently placed on the opposite table) and bash the ATM to smithereens (it awards 100BB) - Suggested by NotASDF on our discord

[b]Added a thirst meter[/b]

This is a massive change. Thirst, hunger, health, and sanity are all separate stats now. This makes food items very valuable and balancing operations will be carried out in the future to attempt to make the stats engaging and a constant threat.

[b]Added ammo saving to several more weapons[/b]

Not a perfect feature (still has some bugs), however ammo now persists across levels. If you use a couple of shots from a Mac-11 to take out a window in level 22, go to 23, go to 20, and somehow find yourself back in 22 (like I did on a stream testing), you will still have the same amount of ammo in your mac-11 as when you left off shooting. This applies to all magazine-fed weapons right now, however it will be applied to shotguns and grenade launchers later.

Now for some rapid-fire changes:

[b]De-janked the escalators in level 201
Made windows not do damage to you in No Entities mode or No Sanity mode
Removed the hub entrance from the ragerooms
Fixed some collision issues with the MP7
Added Clump and Duller Removal setting - Suggested by LunaNightZ on our discord
Rearranged a few walls in level 0[/b]

New this week: Crafting Changes, QOL changes, Fall Event, and more. This is a BETA update. Please use the Beta branch in BrVR's steam library page -> gear icon -> properties -> betas.

[b]Added Halloween Event[/b]

There is a Halloween/Fall event in the Level 11 MEG Base's Convention Hall. Be sure to stop by! They are selling four new limited time items: Spooky/Halloween themed variants of glowsticks, torches, balloon guns, and Seal Flex. Also, guess how many almonds are in this jar! Putting your answer on discord could give you a special prize: a Mac-11 Skin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/723702a6800ffd7b3f33b6644c931b9c77da8d48.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/1dd9766764ef2f5944db5b3fc2585a9a44091c0c.png[/img]

[b]Screwdriver now snaps back into the backpack[/b]

A simple change, but hey, makes using the screwdriver more bearable! It snaps back just like the backpack does to your back, so as to have no more infinite screwdrivers. Screwdrivers now have no interaction collision when in their slot, and they now can pop balloons!

[b]Added more rooms to the level 0 sprawl[/b]

Many connector halls and a new room have been added to level 0's sprawl area. These include an area with several chairs similarly designed to a room from the 2nd newest Kane Pixels video, an area with a long plank that acts as a ramp up to the adjacent hallway, and more.

[b]Flamethower enhancements[/b]

The flamethrower now acts as more of a full-auto fire shotgun. There is a faster "fire rate", more spread of the fire, and a random chance for a Dragon's Breath styled projectile to come out. Ammo depletes more slowly.

[b]Prevented more hard mode cheese[/b]

When you turn on hard mode, the balloon gun by the vault deletes itself now, along with any items spawned from the vault. When dying in the backrooms, items are now unsaved and won't come back with you to the frontrooms (was an intentional effect but was considered cheese by players). 

[b]Grenades now damage balloons[/b]

Simple change: grenades, when exploding, will pop balloons in their explosion radius. Makes for some pretty fun shenanigans when you spawn many more balloons than your PC can handle.

[b]Crafting Changes[/b]

Firesalt crystals are back and can be mined in levels 5 and 8 (the old locations in level 5 have been removed/altered). They can be used to craft firesalt grenades and scarabacks, two new crafting recipes. Drills have been mostly removed from levels. Drills can now be bought or crafted.

notes.title: V. 3.53 MAIN BRANCH UPDATE
notes.content:
[h1]This update is back on the main branch! If you are on the beta branch, you will also be updated to this version automatically.[/h1]

[b]Revamped level 571[/b]

Tons of dirt and props have been added to level 571's five maps. The day/night lighting has been adjusted in part 3 as well as making the skin-stealer encounter there much more terrifying. Shadows have been added to many areas, and overall the lighting is much improved. Trims have been added to around 90% of the walls in the level. Part 4 now has more dizzying non-Euclidean effects.

[b]You can now dispense water from the warm or cool side[/b]

Since water coolers were first added, you have only been able to dispense water from the cold side. Now, if you want warm water, you can have it. Why? All in the name of "immersion" I guess!

Now for some rapid-fire changes:

[b]Adjusted level 40 AI
Did some subtle lighting changes to level 40
Whitened the whiteout
Added fouling to the ceiling tiles
Reinforced level 4 floor
Keypad now shows previous numbers
Replaced level 4 fire extinguisher model[/b]

Here are some things that are new this week:

[h1][b]Now, if you were on the main branch you'll get a ton of other stuff from past beta updates:[/b][/h1]

[b]Level 4 complete revamp[/b]

Level 4 has received a complete top-to-bottom overhaul. The map is larger, the MEG base has been upgraded to be more like Base Alpha, the windows are recessed into the walls, and more. The same achievements and easter eggs from before are still in-game, but in higher graphical fidelity. There are even small details like air conditioners you can turn on and off. There are a few different areas, namely the main area that looks like the pictures, the dark area with smilers and a spooky puzzle, and an 80s themed area which will be built out more soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/ba77f495340aaae9fa624218f49e53f260de769b.png[/img]

[b]New food tubs[/b]

A couple new food tubs have been added including fried clump giblets and skin cake. Tasty! Suggested by @smiley on our discord.

[b]New balloon gun propeller upgrade[/b]

If you upgrade a balloon gun with metal, you will get a small propeller on the back now. This propeller will allow you to move around if you have balloons tied to yourself, making some challenges such as the level 3999 water cooler task easier. The propeller controls are bound to the left joystick since you can't move in midair.

[b]New weapon: balloonderbuss[/b]

Imagine Fortnite's gameplay programmers fell into the backrooms and all turned into partygoers, then decided to make a new weapon. That's exactly what the Balloonderbuss is. Shove in a pack of balloons, prime back the hammer, and you can shoot out balloons very far. The amount of balloons that actually comes out varies, but it's more than enough to levitate the average entity.

[b]Replaced eating and drinking noises[/b]

This was bound to happen. Let's face it: the drinking noise has long sounded like peeing. Both of the noises have been improved.

[b]Level 19 changes[/b]

A new chunk has been added to level 19, the crawlspace. Rare chunks are now much more common, adding more variance to an already varied level. Deathmoths and passive moths have been added. Deathmoths appear in 1/40 hallways, passive moths appear in 1/20.

[b]Added Disgusting Insects[/b]

Seven types of new bugs have been added to levels. They can appear anywhere, but especially in dark, damp levels like levels 2, 3, and 15. There are stag beetles, dragonflies, small spiders, moths, deathmoths, flies, and gnats. The first five listed all have rudimentary AI, but the flies and gnats are just particles.

[b]Added Swatter[/b]

A swatter has been added to deal with the new infestations! It can be found in the tan openable crates, and can squash beetles and spiders. It cannot squash airborne insects for the time being.

[b]Revamped the furniture store[/b]

The furniture store now has 16 different buyable items! Once an item is bought, it will be sent to your frontrooms apartment. Your purchases save. Sadly, there is no way to reposition the furniture as of now. The furniture store can be found in the frontrooms city

[b]Apartment changes[/b]

The apartment now has several new pieces of furniture that are replaced once you buy other pieces of furniture. The basement has gotten a complete overhaul. The hound puppy has been removed, the lights have been darkened, and there are more dirt decals to name a few changes. More doors now separate the rooms. The staircase that allows you to no-clip into the backrooms has been moved downstairs into the basement as well. Moving away from the basement, several more things in the upstairs are grabbable such as the chairs. The wallpaper material has been changed, and will be able to be edited in the future.

[b]Optimization[/b]

Several high-detail meshes have been optimized and cut down for VR usage. Many of the models that we used to create the frontrooms had very high poly counts and needed to be optimized heavily.

[b]Added Storage Scuffle[/b]

A new minigame has been added to level 70! Bid on a self-storage locker against skin stealers, but don't overbid or else you will lose cash. If you outsmart the skin-stealers, you can win big backrooms bucks! To enter the minigame, look for a self-storage locker in level 70 with a green light and enter it. Based on a real TV show.

[b]Resized the Frontrooms Basement[/b]

The Frontrooms basement is not finished by any stretch of the imagination, but it's been resized so that it's much less awkward-looking. The trophy room has been made much smaller, compressing the trophies into a small area.

[b]Added URL Tablet[/b]

Go into GEAT in the frontrooms to retrieve the URL Tablet. You can open URLs with it, including music. Just make sure to pause the audio before going into another level. It's an extremely experimental feature.

[b]Resized Level 0 and 4 Carpet[/b]

Previously, it looked a bit too large, to the point where it was difficult to tell that it was carpet. This is fixed.

[b]Added 5 New Loading Screen Messages[/b]

These 5 new loading screen messages teach about the game's settings such as Hard Mode, Backrooms Items Only, and the no-clip-a-matic doors settings. 

And now, for some rapid-fire changes. There are a lot:

[b]"Johnny" now cannot be killed by balloons
Removed weird blue bar in level 3
Removed backrooms bank
Fixed door in arenainfinite
Fixed Meg Base Alpha laser hit detection
Fixed skin-stealer and smiler AI issues
Fixed BAR recoil and hand position issues
Fixed PPSH recoil
Decreased AK fire rate
Made some subtle balancing changes with weapons
Added a separate room for the level 4 barracks
Fixed some level run lighting issues
Added room number to level 13's room service minigame
Flipped levels 369 and 370 in the hub
Fixed the level 0 partygoer clipping into walls
Widened the tutorial doors
Fixed a couple of issues with the furniture system
Fixed infinite partygoer spawning in level 4
Fixed some issues with the revolver only allowing you to shoot 5 shots sometimes[/b]
[b]Added SFX to the memory worm
Improved upgrade bench + menu hit detection
Finally fixed the level 18 locker maze game
Added trigger/button helper to restart when dead
Added grass to level 11.1
You can now put friend water in squirt gun
Added cha-ching noise for putting money in pocket[/b]

Join our discord https://discord.gg/Px6jpjFEt6

Wishlist our other game Bread or Dead VR and try the playtest

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2380600/Bread_or_Dead/

notes.title: V. 3.48, MAIN BRANCH UPDATE
notes.content:
[h1]This update is back on the main branch! If you are on the beta branch, you will also be updated to this version automatically.[/h1]

Here are some things that are new this week:

[b]Revamped level 17[/b]

Huge improvements from the ground up have been made to level 17. The level looks much more like a real aircraft carrier now, containing several revamped rooms and many more props. The new version is more uniform in size and quality, has accurate-to-life props, and contains more imperfections.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/888ddc31d5e68acffbfdb972082c054f6869c1d5.png[/img]

[b]Added level -7[/b]

Level 2 makes itself scary by having many entities and a dark atmosphere. Imagine a level being scary because of the exact opposite! When you turn on the light switch in level -7, a singular entity spawns whose idea of fun is disemboweling human wanderers. The worst part is that he is very difficult to defeat, although some explosives will do the trick. Simply turning off the light makes him go away, but then you can't complete the level. There are several keys scattered around the house in which the level takes place. These keys are required to exit, but can only be found when the light is on. See why it's scary now?

[b]Added level 38[/b]

Imagine you smashed levels 0-37 together and then made it playable. This is pretty much level 38. There are traits of many different levels all in a shell that looks like level 0.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/e6561df5089cabc4fcf8da8ba7d8514d6802799f.png[/img]

Here you can see many of these traits. Level 0 wallpaper and carpet, level 23 trees, level 22 rubble, level 20 machines, level 27 waterfall, poolrooms tiles, level 8 stalagmites, level 18 toys, and level 2 pipes.

[b]Added level 70[/b]

YES, three levels in one week. Level 70 is a self storage facility at dark, which has openable containers. You can often find random loot in the containers, but guns are very rare.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/b175707beb04b77715e37ba388ca92c6d8271edd.png[/img]

[b]Added metal barricade[/b]

A new thing that can be built with the building blueprint. Allows you to repel entities, but you can still jump over it to get out.

[b]Added hazmat skin-stealers[/b]

A skin-stealer in a hazmat suit, what did you expect? These can be found on the new level 70, but can also be found in levels 15 and 2.

[h1][b]Now, if you were on the main branch you'll get a ton of other stuff from past beta updates:[/b][/h1]

[b]Added many new options for doors[/b]

Now, you can pick between several different types of door pictures that go on the front of no-clip-a-matics. There are five options now instead of two. The options are Normal, like it starts out; Destroy, which removes the picture entirely; Glitch, which replaces the picture with a z-fighting texture; Glitch B, which replaces the picture with a flipbook animated wallpaper material; and Interior, which replaces the picture with an industrial-looking interior cubemap.

[b]Added back Killed By[/b]

Remember when you were able to see what killed you? Well, now you can again! It is located on the last row of your watch.

[b]Fixed the dying in slomo bug[/b]

Simple fix, this ensures that if you die while having the slomo setting on, you will not be trapped in slomo.

[b]Made level !-! Infinite[/b]

Now, on the exit chunk of !-! there is a new hallway behind the door that allows you to keep running level !-!.

[b]Added more goofy ahh mode sounds[/b]

Some new sounds for the airhorn and for getting dropped out of the map have been added.

[b]Fixed !-! Traps[/b]

The traps in level !-! now have the newer trap model, are facing inwards, have a base piece, and have a much better hitbox than before.

[b]Added better partygoer balloon animations[/b]

The balloon now follows the X and Y position of the hand directly, instead of it floating without attachment. This makes it all look much more natural.

[b]Made many changes to level -8[/b]

The minecart has been temporarily disabled until we find a better solution for it. The Tall Shadow has also been nerfed slightly.

[b]Adjusted M1 Garand Hand Hold[/b]

A user was having trouble aiming the M1 Garand, so hopefully this change will help fix that.

[b]Added Building Blueprint Beta[/b]

THIS IS A VERY EXPERIMENTAL FEATURE! A new item, the building blueprint, has been added to Moe's Building Supplies in level 1. It allows you to build custom structures and objects in the backrooms which you can return to at will. Currently, you can build 6 different pieces: Wooden walls, wooden walls with windows, wooden walls with doorframes, wall torches, crafting tables, and upgrade benches.

Any structures you make will (hopefully) save automatically. I have run into a couple of saving issues while testing though, and those will be ironed out in the coming weeks. The UI will also be overhauled and more features will be added like different types of walls, a buildable vault, and a rack to save items on.

The building blueprint costs 15,000 Backrooms Bucks and can be bought at level 1's Moe's Building Supplies.

[b]Hard Mode Door Adjustments[/b]

The other thing we have this week (a lot of effort went into the blueprint) is some adjustments to doors in hard mode. Doors in hard mode will now be stripped of their text, leaving some confusion as to where they go. However, if you hear a faint siren beware, as there is now a 1/150 chance for them to lead to level RUN.

[b]Added sounds and new UI to the building blueprint[/b]

New sounds for creating/destroying things have been added. In addition, the buttons now have rounded corners like the crafting UI. Several small things have been fixed as well.

[b]Added increments to the auto regen health setting[/b]

The regeneration speed can now be set to slow, medium and fast. It still only applies once health is lower than half.

[b]Changed several shell ejection and recoil values[/b]

The MP7 and ASVAL now have some backwards recoil, the PPSH doesn't eject shells with nearly the velocity, and the AK-47 has an increased fire rate.

[b]Screwdriver is now always in your backpack[/b]

There is now a slot on the side of the backpack that always will contain a screwdriver for easy access. Funny known bug, you will now always spawn with a screwdriver right below you.

[b]Added several new areas to level 0[/b]

Some new halls and spooky events have been added. These new areas provide some refuge from entities as well, and just some more halls to get lost in.

[b]Added fireworks to the bazooka[/b]

Happy 4th to those in the US! The partygoer confetti rounds now provide the bazooka with a firework-styled projectile instead of the normal confetti projectile.

[b]Removed the usage for forks[/b]

Now you can stuff your entire face into a tub of food like a pig! This goes for Royal Rations, Hound Meat Stew, and Scraps.

[b]Almond water now restores less hunger[/b]

This was a balancing change requested because...almond water is a drink. The stats for sanity and health have not been changed though.

[b]Added metal walls to the building blueprint[/b]

There is a new wall type on the building blueprint: metal walls. These can be built with four I-Beams, which equates to 12 workable metal. For reference, the wooden walls require 14 wood logs. More coming soon.

[b]Gotten rid of an infinite money glitch with chips[/b]

Now, you cannot put casino chips in the vault! I have no idea why they were able to be put in there in the first place, but woot.

[b]Optimized the frontrooms apartment a bit[/b]

Many meshes in the frontrooms apartment hadn't gotten proper LODs, now they have them!

[b]Adjusted right stick deadzone[/b]

The right stick's crouch deadzone is now set to be a much higher value than before.

Now for some rapid-fire changes:

[b]Added goofy ahh music to level 31[/b]
[b]Added an obsidian floor to the top of level 28[/b]
[b]Added a smoother animation to the m79[/b]
[b]Added an ambidextrous energy marker to the laser gun
Removed many guns from level 13
Reduced the cost of the building blueprint
Added a bulk wood buyer to Moe's Building Supplies [/b]

tags.feature:
[b]Revamped level 17[/b]

Huge improvements from the ground up have been made to level 17. The level looks much more like a real aircraft carrier now, containing several revamped rooms and many more props. The new version is more uniform in size and quality, has accurate-to-life props, and contains more imperfections.

[b]Added level -7[/b]

Level 2 makes itself scary by having many entities and a dark atmosphere. Imagine a level being scary because of the exact opposite! When you turn on the light switch in level -7, a singular entity spawns whose idea of fun is disemboweling human wanderers. The worst part is that he is very difficult to defeat, although some explosives will do the trick. Simply turning off the light makes him go away, but then you can't complete the level. There are several keys scattered around the house in which the level takes place. These keys are required to exit, but can only be found when the light is on. See why it's scary now?

[b]Added level 38[/b]

Imagine you smashed levels 0-37 together and then made it playable. This is pretty much level 38. There are traits of many different levels all in a shell that looks like level 0.

[b]Added level 70[/b]

YES, three levels in one week. Level 70 is a self storage facility at dark, which has openable containers. You can often find random loot in the containers, but guns are very rare.

[b]Added metal barricade[/b]

A new thing that can be built with the building blueprint. Allows you to repel entities, but you can still jump over it to get out.

[b]Added hazmat skin-stealers[/b]

A skin-stealer in a hazmat suit, what did you expect? These can be found on the new level 70, but can also be found in levels 15 and 2.

[b]Added many new options for doors[/b]

Now, you can pick between several different types of door pictures that go on the front of no-clip-a-matics. There are five options now instead of two. The options are Normal, like it starts out; Destroy, which removes the picture entirely; Glitch, which replaces the picture with a z-fighting texture; Glitch B, which replaces the picture with a flipbook animated wallpaper material; and Interior, which replaces the picture with an industrial-looking interior cubemap.

[b]Added back Killed By[/b]

Remember when you were able to see what killed you? Well, now you can again! It is located on the last row of your watch.

notes.title: V. 3.43, MAIN BRANCH UPDATE
notes.content:
[h1]This update is back on the main branch! If you are on the beta branch, you will also be updated to this version automatically.[/h1]

Here are some things that are new this week:

[b]Revamped the majority of th3 sh4dy gr3y[/b]

Level0Zero, Level1One, and Level3Three have all gotten several enhancements such as better lighting, more props, shadows, and new landscapes. Level3three now has swimmable water.

[b]Made the woodrooms much spookier[/b]

A few new rooms have been added to the woodrooms, and so have some new entities. Specifically, lurkers from level 9. The hounds have been removed.

[b]Added new vault sorting options[/b]

The vault can now be sorted through in two ways. Firstly, there are two alphabetical sorters, one for A-M and one from N-Z. Secondly, there is a new favorites list. Any item can be favorited via a button, and then filtered through with the "filter by favorites" button. You can spawn all of your favorites with the aptly named "spawn favorites" button.

[b]Added a slot radius option[/b]

An option has now been added to increase/decrease hip slot radius by 5 centimeters.

[b]Hunger and sanity now persist across levels[/b]
[b]Made some adjustments to the hub
Fixed a myriad of small bugs
Made several guns unable to be put in the backpack
Added size 4 to the spray painter
Added water physics to Level 63[/b]

[h1][b]Now, if you were on the main branch you'll get a ton of other stuff from past beta updates:[/b][/h1]

[b]Revamped level 1one[/b]

Level 1one has gotten some significant changes, including the addition of new paintings and props. Walls now align much better. The lighting on the level has also been turned down, giving a more creepy atmosphere. The two AK rifles near spawn have been removed.

[b]Added footsteps to many more surfaces[/b]

Most surfaces will now generate a footstep sound, adding some realism to the act of walking or sprinting.

[b]Added a headbob setting[/b]

Now in settings, you can enable a headbob setting that will kick on whilst sprinting. The camera will move up and down subtly, as if you were actually running.

[b]Fixed the one item in backpack bug[/b]

A huge bug now squashed for eternity! Now you can carry as many chicken pieces as you'd like from one level to another without them turning into little crumbs. Same goes for any other item.

[b]Adjusted the head slot[/b]

Although this is not the case for some items, generally speaking, the hand left behind after eating food will not attempt to grab whatever is in the head slot now.

[b]Improved Malt Mart[/b]

Malt Mart uses kiosks now instead of the items all laying about. The faceling behind the counter is still just as aggressive...

[b]Added more props to level FUN[/b]

The level FUN revamp last week was still a WIP, now it's much closer to completion with the addition of more props like play fences and FUN wall decals.

[b]Revamped level negative 2[/b]

Level negative 2 has gotten a complete overhaul. We started from scratch and built up a huge new level that is over twice as large as the old one (in terms of commonly travelled areas) and is much more detailed. Low-quality models have been swapped out with high-quality ones, and every dirt stain has been placed to make the level feel just a bit less clean and more eerie. You certainly still aren't alone to explore these catacombs by yourself; there are facelings and many hounds attempting to hunt you down. The blue hallways that originally served as a link from the flooded areas to the large dark room now serve as a link between different parts of the level. These hallways have seven different connections to other areas now. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/0b0be074fec983c599dc34bb1b5bc910392b296c.png[/img]

[b]Revamped level FUN[/b]

Level FUN is still a work-in-progress when it comes to furnishing. It will be improved in the coming updates. For now, there are many more play structures than before, even featuring a multi-level playplace that is fully explorable (picture below). There will be an even larger one in the future, that's for sure. The new version is a static level, compared to the procedurally generated one that was there. However, there is still a door to get to the procedurally generated section.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/3b8e36162ff47c73bfeed2701c230d8f35e21104.png[/img]

[b]Revamped the Terror Hotel Casino[/b]

The casino is now crowded with slots machines everywhere you look. It is now a maze of blinding lights and mystifying sounds to get from one game to the next, compounded by the multiple ambient voices emanating from the games. The casino now feels much more "real", as it is now densely packed with games. Instead of using kiosks to buy chips, The Beast of Level 5 will hand them to you. There are two new games, video poker and the backrooms lottery, which both have their own section on this changelog.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/9983c9858cf3f4dcf281f8e1914d67b2ba3493ae.png[/img]

[b]Added video poker[/b]

An exciting game, video poker is very similar to a "9/6 Jacks or Better" machine from the frontrooms. You put a token in and hit draw to be dealt a hand. Then, you choose the cards you would like to hold and press draw again. The cards you have not held will be re-rolled, and that will be your final hand. You will be dealt chips based on what that hand is. The only difference between in-game video poker and frontrooms video poker is that the pay tables are slightly different. You get paid a bit more in-game for worse hands than you would in real life.

[b]Added backrooms lottery[/b]

A fun vending machine now sits in the corner of the Terror Hotel Casino. You can purchase a ticket for one chip, and then scratch it off. Your odds are 225:1 at winning, but if you do win, you will receive $15000.

[b]Added a way to spawn steel beams for trap building[/b]

Building traps for entities has never been easier! All you have to do is press the button on the new UI and the metal will spawn for building. The metal is taken out of the same inventory used for crafting.

[b]Added a new delete gun persistence setting[/b]

In V. 3.39, we removed the ability to take the delete gun between levels. This change is now toggleable via a setting.

[b]Slightly decreased general payout[/b]

As most people who were grinding (on our discord at least) have now made their money, it seems as though it is the best time to adjust payouts for certain jobs. Most everything, including the level 20 crate minigame, the level 24 plastic factory minigame, the bartending and room service minigames on level 13, the casino in level 5, and the bounties on level 1 have all been adjusted. Some things that haven't been adjusted are the MEG missions, entity trading cards, and arcade games. All of these ways to make money have been normalized so that one is not exactly better than the others. Some more tweaking is most likely necessary though.

[b]Added a new stats screen to the frontrooms[/b]

There is now a small monitor in the frontrooms that shows four stats about the player. There will be more coming soon.

[b]Added level 63[/b]

After many weeks of work, level 63 is finally here. To put it lightly, this level is massive. It contains three distinct parts: The Canyons, The Floating Isles, and The Eastern Village. 

The Floating Isles are in the center of the map and are where you spawn. They are a set of earthy floating islands with varying sizes. There are special islands such as ones with many cacti, ones with a waterfall coming out of clouds, ones with a shrine, and ones with very large trees. There are some other, more generic islands, some with water and some without.

The Canyons is the area closest to the isles. The Canyons are very reminiscent of the level 37 mountain segment, containing many orange mountains segmented by bridges. There is a valley in the middle with several waterfalls and rivers.

The Eastern Village is a large Asian village on an even larger floating island. The Eastern Village is much more stylized compared to the rest of the map, and is the farthest away from spawn. It is connected to spawn by a very large bridge. 

All in all, level 63 is a massive space to hang out and chill, as it contains no entities. It is meant to be a very relaxing level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/6c1b14f1ec20e25653cde82913c274b12be0ea5f.png[/img]

[b]Added new music to the red poolrooms[/b]

Another incredible theme by @LunaNightZ on our discord has been added to the game. Thanks!

[b]Added some graphical improvements to level 16[/b]

Some things, such as the snow texture and variance in the landscape have been adjusted slightly.

Now for some rapid-fire changes:

[b]Added a better trap model
Added many new music tracks
Made skin-stealer animations smoother
Added a small pool to level 33
Changed much of the lighting on level 33 to be higher-quality[/b]

notes.title: V. 3.41
notes.content:
ATTENTION: If you haven't yet: go to BrVR's steam library page -> gear icon -> properties -> betas -> and opt into this update by selecting the beta branch. This is to reduce unwanted update downloads for people on the stable main branch.

A huge update today. But first, I would like to mention some breaking Backrooms news. The original Backrooms picture's location has been found and confirmed by several sources. In case you haven't heard, feel free to look it up. It was in a building where an RC car racetrack would then be set up. Perhaps an RC car racetrack easter egg in BrVR is due. Anyways, on to the update.

[b]Revamped level negative 2[/b]

Level negative 2 has gotten a complete overhaul. We started from scratch and built up a huge new level that is over twice as large as the old one (in terms of commonly travelled areas) and is much more detailed. Low-quality models have been swapped out with high-quality ones, and every dirt stain has been placed to make the level feel just a bit less clean and more eerie. You certainly still aren't alone to explore these catacombs by yourself; there are Facelings and many hounds attempting to hunt you down. The blue hallways that originally served as a link from the flooded areas to the large dark room now serve as a link between different parts of the level. These hallways have seven different connections to other areas now. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/0b0be074fec983c599dc34bb1b5bc910392b296c.png[/img]

[b]Revamped level FUN[/b]

Level FUN is still a work-in-progress when it comes to furnishing. It will be improved in the coming updates. For now, there are many more play structures than before, even featuring a multi-level playplace that is fully explorable (picture below). There will be an even larger one in the future, that's for sure. The new version is a static level, compared to the procedurally generated one that was there. However, there is still a door to get to the procedurally generated section.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/3b8e36162ff47c73bfeed2701c230d8f35e21104.png[/img]

[b]Revamped the Terror Hotel Casino[/b]

The casino is now crowded with slots machines everywhere you look. It is now a maze of blinding lights and mystifying sounds to get from one game to the next, compounded by the multiple ambient voices emanating from the games. The casino now feels much more "real", as it is now densely packed with games. Instead of using kiosks to buy chips, The Beast of Level 5 will hand them to you. There are two new games, video poker and the backrooms lottery, which both have their own section on this changelog.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/9983c9858cf3f4dcf281f8e1914d67b2ba3493ae.png[/img]

[b]Added video poker[/b]

An exciting game, video poker is very similar to a "9/6 Jacks or Better" machine from the frontrooms. You put a token in and hit draw to be dealt a hand. Then, you choose the cards you would like to hold and press draw again. The cards you have not held will be re-rolled, and that will be your final hand. You will be dealt chips based on what that hand is. The only difference between in-game video poker and frontrooms video poker is that the pay tables are slightly different. You get paid a bit more in-game for worse hands than you would in real life.

[b]Added backrooms lottery[/b]

A fun vending machine now sits in the corner of the Terror Hotel Casino. You can purchase a ticket for one chip, and then scratch it off. Your odds are 225:1 at winning, but if you do win, you will receive $15000.

[b]Added a way to spawn steel beams for trap building[/b]

Building traps for entities has never been easier! All you have to do is press the button on the new UI and the metal will spawn for building. The metal is taken out of the same inventory used for crafting.

[b]Added a new delete gun persistence setting[/b]

In V. 3.39, we removed the ability to take the delete gun between levels. This change is now toggleable via a setting.

[b]Slightly decreased general payout[/b]

As most people who were grinding (on our discord at least) have now made their money, it seems as though it is the best time to adjust payouts for certain jobs. Most everything, including the level 20 crate minigame, the level 24 plastic factory minigame, the bartending and room service minigames on level 13, the casino in level 5, and the bounties on level 1 have all been adjusted. Some things that haven't been adjusted are the MEG missions, entity trading cards, and arcade games. All of these ways to make money have been normalized so that one is not exactly better than the others. Some more tweaking is most likely necessary though.

[b]Added a new stats screen to the frontrooms[/b]

There is now a small monitor in the frontrooms that shows four stats about the player. There will be more coming soon.

Now for some rapid-fire changes:

[b]Added a better trap model
Added many new music tracks
Made skin-stealer animations smoother
Added a small pool to level 33
Changed much of the lighting on level 33 to be higher-quality[/b]

notes.title: V. 3.40 "The Ultimate Calming Update"
notes.content:
ATTENTION: If you haven't yet: go to BrVR's steam library page -> gear icon -> properties -> betas -> and opt into this update by selecting the beta branch. This is to reduce unwanted update downloads for people on the stable main branch.

[b]Added level 63[/b]

After many weeks of work, level 63 is finally here. To put it lightly, this level is massive. It contains three distinct parts: The Canyons, The Floating Isles, and The Eastern Village. 

The Floating Isles are in the center of the map and are where you spawn. They are a set of earthy floating islands with varying sizes. There are special islands such as ones with many cacti, ones with a waterfall coming out of clouds, ones with a shrine, and ones with very large trees. There are some other, more generic islands, some with water and some without.

The Canyons is the area closest to the isles. The Canyons are very reminiscent of the level 37 mountain segment, containing many orange mountains segmented by bridges. There is a valley in the middle with several waterfalls and rivers.

The Eastern Village is a large Asian village on an even larger floating island. The Eastern Village is much more stylized compared to the rest of the map, and is the farthest away from spawn. It is connected to spawn by a very large bridge. 

All in all, level 63 is a massive space to hang out and chill, as it contains no entities. It is meant to be a very relaxing level.

notes.title: V. 3.39, MAIN BRANCH UPDATE
notes.content:
[h1]This update is back on the main branch! If you are on the beta branch, you will also be updated to this version automatically.[/h1]

Here are some things that are new this week:

[b]Gave the partygoer a new set of animations[/b]

Partygoers now have many new animations, including ones for walking, running, idling, attacking, and more. There are even "sad" animations for when the balloon is popped. The tooth-filled arm is now on both hands as well and more properly blends into the rest of the body.

[b]Improved Scope eye relief[/b]

Scopes now have proper eye relief and depth simulation instead of being completely flat. The scope also has an improved reticle and the display is a bit darker.

[b]Changed Goofy Ahh Footstep sounds[/b]

Enabling goofy ahh mode (introduced on April Fools) will now cause all footsteps to turn into "dink dink dink" noises. Voiced by none other than me.

[b]Made squirt guns craftable[/b]

For 15 pieces of plastic, you can now craft a squirt gun at any crafting table. You cannot craft the UMK or Big Squirt yet, but you can craft the Lil Squirt.

[b]Changed Checkpoints[/b]

Checkpoints are now represented by chairs instead of awkward concrete pillars. A noise now plays when you save via the checkpoint as well.

[b]Added tooltips[/b]

Around 39 items now have proper tooltips telling you either what the object is or how to operate it. Tooltips stay on the screen for 5 seconds after use, and then they do not appear again on that item. More tooltips for guns coming soon.

Now for some rapid-fire changes:

MEG tag now properly sticks to hand
Text under bars now tells you what the bar is for
Branding now sticks correctly to the M4A1
Disabled delete gun in other levels
Made it so that the double barrel shotgun opens at a 15 degree angle instead of a 45 degree angle
Changed AK round position
Improved level 18 foliage
Fixed High-capacity 870 collision

[h1][b]Now, if you were on the main branch you'll get a ton of other stuff from past beta updates:[/b][/h1]

[b]Added many new entity noises[/b]

Wretches now make footsteps, have a custom alarm noise, and a custom roaming noise. Hounds now have a better, creepier barking noise as well.

[b]Added an entity frequency setting[/b]

Once enabled, this setting will delete half of the entities on a level. It requires a restart of the level to take effect though. Some entities, such as clumps, dullers, and deathmoths will not be deleted.

[b]Added keep inventory setting[/b]

This setting allows the player to keep their items upon most instances of death. Some instances of death, such as dying in level RUN, does not allow you to keep your items. This setting is experimental because it can sometimes cause physics issues.

[b]Revamped level 998[/b]

Twas in a poll, and now is here. The level 998 revamp has a much better staircase area, with a nice shadow pouring in from the top window (only available on high shadow settings). The outdoor area now has more fog, although the area is not done and will be finished up before the main branch drop next week.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/45b9d0de8d8b3d13de9c8245fc90a6e5c7af6ccd.png[/img]

[b]Added more spawn locations to level 9[/b]

Most houses in level 9 now have spawn points. Some adjustments have been made to level 9 as well, like crushing in some doors.

[b]Added level 217[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/8d7e99b27cc1c64493f8d6910dae69551edf409f.png[/img]

Level 217 is finally here, a liminal and safe level set on a space station. You can use clump guns to move around the pieces of space junk that are floating around the station, and eventually that will be tied to a clean-up mission.

[b]Added level 3.1[/b]

In another space-related change, level 3.1 is now here. A fresh new procedural level, level 3.1 is full of rocket silos, offices, and other rooms with various pieces of equipment in them. Think of level 3.1 as "ground control" for level 217.

[b]Adjusted level 3[/b]

Level 3 is now properly colored and lit. In addition, there are now many new pieces of rubble and there is more rubble scatter. Lastly, there are some new entity spawners to give variance to the entities encountered.

[b]Changed entity AI and added many new sounds and animations to them[/b]

Generally entities are a bit smarter now, and have some new truly terrifying sounds to boot! There are many changes with the sounds, like new alarm and chasing sounds for facelings, new footstep sounds for partygoers, faclings, and hounds, and the smiler sounds engaging only upon player detection.

[b]Added a couple of new paths to level 666[/b]

Level 666 now has a couple of new paths. There is a fake level 0, a Japanese shrine area, and a few new creepy hallways! Previously, it was just a straight shot from the start to the finish. Not anymore.

And now, for a couple of rapid-fire changes:

[b]Fixed gameplay settings menu[/b]
[b]Added a playhouse to the first level 18 hall[/b]
[b]Added some new props to level 571[/b]
[b]Fixed gameplay setting menu
Added a new area to the level 24 bunker
Batteries can be removed from flashlights
Adjusted the volume and timing of the level -1 music
Fixed an issue with entity friending
Fixed an issue with the m4a1 muzzle flash[/b]
[b].50 BMG now engages ragdoll fling
Fixed a bug with the MP7 shot location
Partygoers are much larger
Added several effects to partygoers
Added custom audio to level 31's roller rink
Added several new decorations to level 31
All crafting materials are now sellable
Raised the pictures up in the elevator area of the frontrooms apartment[/b]

notes.title: V. 3.35, MAIN BRANCH UPDATE
notes.content:
[h1]This update is back on the main branch! If you are on the beta branch, you will also be updated to this version automatically.[/h1]

Here are some things that are new this week:

[b]Added a base to level 24[/b]

A BNTG base has been added to level 24. Unfortunately, the base has been overrun by entities! Clear those out and you'll see that there are tons of supplies in every little section of the building. Suggested by @LunaNightZ on our discord server.

[b]Added the custom gun skins feature to the AK-47[/b]

The custom gun skin feature that we introduced last week is now applied to the AK-47. More will be coming in the near future.

[b]Added some new chunks to level !-![/b]

A couple of new hallway chunks have been added to level !-! for variety. In addition, some bugs have been fixed with the generation.

And now for some rapid-fire changes:

[b]Improved supernova pumping sfx[/b]
[b]Made it so that you can put a suppressor on an MP7
Decreased ppsh-41 firerate
Added a delay to firing the M82
Made more objects in level 18 grabbable
Tech Tree Arena music can now be controlled by music volume slider
Added several new materials to level -1[/b]

[h1][b]Now, if you were on the main branch you'll get a ton of other stuff from past beta updates:[/b][/h1]

[b]Revamped level 18[/b]

A new level 18 is now here! This level revamp may just be the largest one that we've attempted yet. This is only its second week in the game, the first being as a preview. There are still many bugs, but we feel that it is in a good enough state to ship out as a Beta.

There are two maps to level 18, the spawn map and the main map. First, I will talk about the spawn map.

The spawn map is a maze of rooms, separated into three main halls. You start in a large colorful playroom with tons of oversized toys like a xylophone and rocking horse. You can even walk on the xylophone and play it! The first hallway is cloud-themed. There are many oversized dinosaur toys inside of it, among other props. The second hallway is a dark blue kindergarten classroom. There are small rock climbing walls near the edges, and a few toys in the classroom itself. In the back halls of the classroom is a strange area with uncanny AI paintings on the walls. This leads to the main map. The third hallway is a very dark children's bedroom with many blankets and beds. There are also several desks which contain drawings with some of our playtesters' names on them. This room also leads to the main map.

The main map is a vast expanse of childlike areas. It is separated into 6 main areas: the neighborhood, the school, the playground, the tubes, the clouds, and the church. First, the neighborhood contains all sorts of suburban houses similar to those of level 9. These houses contain many bits of trash and surreal scenes like lightbulbs baking on a stovetop. It is heavily implied that kids have lived in these houses at one point or another. Second, the school is an eight-part complex of rooms. The school itself is separated into two parts, the daycare and the high school. The daycare is filled with rooms like a stuffed animal room, a room full of boxes, a locker maze, and more. The high school is filled with rooms like classrooms, cafeterias, and libraries. Third, the playground is a smaller area with a large amount of modern playground equipment. There is also a tennis enclosure there, which you can walk into. Fourth, the tubes is the section that is the most similar to the original level 18. There is a lot of playground equipment here as well, however it is all run-down Russian playground equipment instead of modern American equipment. The area is categorized by a maze of playground tubes similar to the original. Fifth, you can take a rocket in the tube area to reach the clouds. This layer is the most barren of the 6 main areas, as it only has a cloud plane and an exit. However, it is a great way to get a top-down view on the map. Lastly, the church is located a bit out of the way. It is beside the school. It seems as if the church is always closed, but it is still an imposing landmark nonetheless.

There are two unique friendly entities in level 18, the Plush Dino and the Booknado. The Plush Dino is a stuffed dinosaur. He will lead you to the rocket ship slowly, but if you pet him he will follow you instead for a short time. The Booknado is a large tornado made of books and can be found in the library.

All of level 18 is categorized by a childlike atmosphere, uncanny proportions, and a strong sense of nostalgia. A great new track by LunaNightZ is in the school. More audio is coming soon though!

[b]Added 5 new meats[/b]

Wretches, Skin-givers, Partygoers, Lighters, and Clumps now all drop meat most of the time. These meats aren't anything special, however some have some interesting effects. For example, the lighter meat has an aura emanating from it.

[b]Added a keypad to the red room in level 2[/b]

The red room radio in level 2 had a set of numbers in the audio file that didn't have any correlation to the game until now. Now there is a keypad that leads to a secret room!

[b]Added "far away entity spawners"[/b]

This is a new feature that continuously spawns entities if there are no entities on the level for some large levels. More entities will spawn if you shoot weapons frequently without a suppressor.

[b]Revamped level !-![/b]

A level !-! revamp was hinted at a couple of devlogs ago, and now it's here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/055f0a741cd06106ab0f1d39e3eca74d0f4f14db.png[/img]

Level !-! is now fully procedural, with around 22 chunks to generate. Many chunks have multiple variants too, with different furniture variations or item placements. There are 3 main types of chunks: Hotel chunks, obstacle chunks, and blue room chunks. Hotel chunks are normal chunks that build most rooms and hallways. They range from hotel halls to laundry rooms, to receptions rooms and more. Obstacle chunks have special challenges to overcome similar to level RUN's obstacles. Mazes of barrels and fences, hallway blockages, split hallways with two fates, trap rooms, and many more. Lastly, blue rooms can generate which are safe havens where entities cannot go.

[b]Added several props to level 5[/b]

This is part of an ongoing project to revamp level 5, and it will continue into next week. This week though, the rooms on the side of the main lobby and the rooms in the suites area have been revamped. Many more rooms will be redone in the next update.

Here's a before and after:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/e6d931f23082ef2e7fa79ec42f927b501c24f002.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/d18647a90d3b5720f31db8eaa82c1732645df767.png[/img]

[b]Added new audio to level 18[/b]

Several audio files such as kids playing, cafeteria noise, and classroom ambience have been added to Level 18's main map. Do note, we had thought that we had fixed the grass in level 18 not showing, however, we could not seem to fix that issue in time for the update.

[b]Added new chunks to Level Fun[/b]

A couple of new wall color variations have been added to Level Fun.

[b]Revamped level 31[/b]

Level 31 has gotten a facelift. It is much darker now and has typical arcade theming. The carpet and walls all have multicolored 90s patterns, there is now steam in the main area, and there is a new model for skates. You all voted for this level on our discord polls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/4f2ce08d82416c5fcde5750b6cb4f16c9da24863.png[/img]

[b]Improved mk3 operation[/b]

The force required to pull the bolt has been decreased, tolerances have been worked on for interaction points, and the animation has been improved to take less time.

[b]Categorized gameplay settings[/b]

Gameplay settings is now divided into three parts: the first is a technical part containing system settings and controls, the second is devoted to gameplay options, the third is for more fun settings. Suggested by @LUKA on our discord.

[b]Added MP7 SMG[/b]

A new SMG has been added, the MP7. This top-charged, 30 round SMG is a more accurate and deadly SMG than the Mac-11, while being less bulky than SMGs like the Vector. The community voted on this in a poll.

[b]Added Barrett M82[/b]

A new rifle has been added, the Barrett M82. This .50 BMG Anti-Materiel Rifle is a hefty piece of machinery. It doesn't work very well as a primary or a secondary, but is instead meant for a support weapon role. This rifle can be seen in levels 3, 4, and 11 protecting MEG bases. The community voted on this in a poll.

[b]Added mac-11 custom gun skins[/b]

The Mac-11 now has a custom gun skin system. You can apply the custom skin in the gun store. Then, to choose the texture, upload it to the internet, copy the link, create a file in a directory C:/BrVRFiles called m11.txt, and paste the link in there. Templates are in the discord server under #guides.

[b]Overhauled many rooms in the starting area of level 25[/b]

The starting area of level 25 has gotten a facelift, receiving updates to many rooms. There is now on average more lighting and detail. More vending machines are now present, and several of the walls have been replaced with futuristic ones from level 201.

[b]Improved bounciness[/b]

Bounciness of the player against walls has been improved, however half-height objects still bounce just as much.

[b]Added the spaceroom[/b]

Ah yes, an orange room in level 18 with two white-out windows and a single school desk in the very middle. Sound familiar? Suggested by @LUKA on our discord.

[b]Added chicken bomb[/b]

This may seem like a strange concept, however it was one of the very first weapons to be in BrVR. It is now back. It is a chicken that you can through at clumps to kill them. There is also a timed detonation system on the chicken itself. Suggested by @Cameraman on our discord.

[b]Improved revolver animation[/b]

The revolver has a new animation when popping out the cylinder.

[b]Added new chunks to level !-![/b]

A pool chunk and a new hallways chunk have been added to level !-!.

Now for some rapid-fire changes:

[b]Fixed collision bugs with !-![/b]
[b]Added several props to level 5[/b]
[b]Increased cyclic rate of 870[/b]
[b]Fixed a bug with cassette audio[/b]
[b]Added more pipe collars to level 2
Fixed the lods on the red room radio
Added a blue tape square to level 0
Turned down the effect of the metro's glow
Added more partygoer balloon color variations
Gun cases now delete themselves in hard mode[/b]
