notes.title: V. 3.32, "The Meat 'n' Potatoes update"
notes.content:
ATTENTION: If you haven't yet: go to BrVR's steam library page -> gear icon -> properties -> betas -> and opt into this update by selecting the beta branch. This is to reduce unwanted update downloads for people on the stable main branch.

[b]Revamped level 18[/b]

A new level 18 is now here! This level revamp may just be the largest one that we've attempted yet. This is only its second week in the game, the first being as a preview. There are still many bugs, but we feel that it is in a good enough state to ship out as a Beta.

There are two maps to level 18, the spawn map and the main map. First, I will talk about the spawn map.

The spawn map is a maze of rooms, separated into three main halls. You start in a large colorful playroom with tons of oversized toys like a xylophone and rocking horse. You can even walk on the xylophone and play it! The first hallway is cloud-themed. There are many oversized dinosaur toys inside of it, among other props. The second hallway is a dark blue kindergarten classroom. There are small rock climbing walls near the edges, and a few toys in the classroom itself. In the back halls of the classroom is a strange area with uncanny AI paintings on the walls. This leads to the main map. The third hallway is a very dark children's bedroom with many blankets and beds. There are also several desks which contain drawings with some of our playtesters' names on them. This room also leads to the main map.

The main map is a vast expanse of childlike areas. It is separated into 6 main areas: the neighborhood, the school, the playground, the tubes, the clouds, and the church. First, the neighborhood contains all sorts of suburban houses similar to those of level 9. These houses contain many bits of trash and surreal scenes like lightbulbs baking on a stovetop. It is heavily implied that kids have lived in these houses at one point or another. Second, the school is an eight-part complex of rooms. The school itself is separated into two parts, the daycare and the high school. The daycare is filled with rooms like a stuffed animal room, a room full of boxes, a locker maze, and more. The high school is filled with rooms like classrooms, cafeterias, and libraries. Third, the playground is a smaller area with a large amount of modern playground equipment. There is also a tennis enclosure there, which you can walk into. Fourth, the tubes is the section that is the most similar to the original level 18. There is a lot of playground equipment here as well, however it is all run-down Russian playground equipment instead of modern American equipment. The area is categorized by a maze of playground tubes similar to the original. Fifth, you can take a rocket in the tube area to reach the clouds. This layer is the most barren of the 6 main areas, as it only has a cloud plane and an exit. However, it is a great way to get a top-down view on the map. Lastly, the church is located a bit out of the way. It is beside the school. It seems as if the church is always closed, but it is still an imposing landmark nonetheless.

There are two unique friendly entities in level 18, the Plush Dino and the Booknado. The Plush Dino is a stuffed dinosaur. He will lead you to the rocket ship slowly, but if you pet him he will follow you instead for a short time. The Booknado is a large tornado made of books and can be found in the library.

All of level 18 is categorized by a childlike atmosphere, uncanny proportions, and a strong sense of nostalgia. A great new track by LunaNightZ is in the school. More audio is coming soon though!

[b]Added 5 new meats[/b]

Wretches, Skin-givers, Partygoers, Lighters, and Clumps now all drop meat most of the time. These meats aren't anything special, however some have some interesting effects. For example, the lighter meat has an aura emanating from it.

[b]Added a keypad to the red room in level 2[/b]

The red room radio in level 2 had a set of numbers in the audio file that didn't have any correlation to the game until now. Now there is a keypad that leads to a secret room!

[b]Added "far away entity spawners"[/b]

This is a new feature that continuously spawns entities if there are no entities on the level for some large levels. More entities will spawn if you shoot weapons frequently without a suppressor.

Now for some rapid-fire changes:

[b]Added more pipe collars to level 2
Fixed the lods on the red room radio
Added a blue tape square to level 0
Turned down the effect of the metro's glow
Added more partygoer balloon color variations
Gun cases now delete themselves in hard mode[/b]

IN OTHER BRVR NEWS

This update it 0.1 GB smaller than the last one. I have been working to compress textures, but bringing down filesize is nowhere near easy.

Nothing else to report as of now.

notes.title: V. 3.31, MAIN BRANCH UPDATE
notes.content:
[h1]This update is back on the main branch! If you are on the beta branch, you will also be updated to this version automatically.[/h1]

Here are some things that are new this week:

[b]Added level 18 preview[/b]

This preview can be found in the legacy museum. It is a technical test and is rather unoptimized, it is not very playable either. More details for it will be coming next week when we (hopefully) drop it.

[b]Added several new liquids[/b]

Luka's almond water brew, K3 Rizz soda, Grim's Kvass, NotASDF's Cashew Water, and Buzti's Backrooms Brew have all been added. We named them all after our playtesters. Thank you Luka, K3, Grimnee, NotASDF, and SherlockBuzti!

[b]Added 3 new songs[/b]

Just like last week, we have more songs from LunaNightZ! These are ambient themes for levels 23, 36, and 369. They're quite calming. Visit Luna's soundcloud at https://soundcloud.com/zerobladerising

[b]Released frowner from his house[/b]

Frowner has been released from the house in the boiler room! Just like in the old days you can now take frowner to other areas of level 5. How sweet...

[h1][b]Now, if you were on the main branch you'll get a ton of other stuff from past beta updates:[/b][/h1]

[b]Added tons of new music and ambience[/b]

With the help of our lovely playtester and contributor LunaNightZ, we have added many new music and ambience tracks to levels. Among these are themes for level Critical, level Theta, level 25, and many more.

You can visit their Soundcloud at https://soundcloud.com/zerobladerising


[b]Revamped MEG base alpha[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/fd205051ae5137922218430134a68c082a206616.png[/img]

This is the third iteration of the MEG base. Featuring all new entrance rooms, lounges, offices, and bathrooms, this iteration is quite expansive. All of the MEG features you know and love from the old base are still here. There are new NPCs and even an MEG cat!

[b]Revamped BNTG trader's vault[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/722b84a07012a397f7cfaa5e14f977d91922b8b5.png[/img]

The level 1 BNTG base is the largest base in-game! Featuring 12 shops and many other buildings, it contains all sorts of goodies to buy and sell. Now the base has gotten a graphical rework, with much more rubble and many more dirty surfaces. Canopies instead of cubic geometry, and trims instead of straight edges. The base as a whole is a bit darker now.

[b]Revamped level 22[/b]

Level 22 has gotten a light revamp, putting more realistic rubble in place of rubble that comes out of no where. More dirt and grime leads to a more ruined atmosphere. In addition, many of the walls are now concrete, giving it a varied feel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/d023e8f2e241bb4be4484e59bce095ae0c05fe81.png[/img]

[b]Added Level 369[/b]

Back a few updates ago we added Level Theta. It was created by a member of our discord named Gatchi13. They did an awesome job sculpting the level in Unreal Engine and then we revised it and put it in-game. So, we did it again. In fact, anyone can submit their levels, as long as it meets our quality standards. Join our discord if you're interested!

Level 369, made by our discord user Dave, is based on the Backrooms Fandom version of the level. It's a large grassy complex of concrete halls, often talked about as "The Grassrooms". Calming wind chimes play in the background. There are three exits. One to level 9 via a key door, one to level 18 via a vine, and one to level 8 via a rocky area. There are physical windchimes that the player can interact with, and also physical vines that the player can crawl up. There are many fruits and foods as well scattered around the outskirts of the level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/33029b0bb84097925d244c2328e6e046c2928217.png[/img]

[b]Added...gun...skins?[/b]

It sounds like a dirty word these days, but I'll tell you, "no microtransactions, ma!"

Jokes aside, there are now 10 new gun skins in this first set for the AS-VAL, AKS-74U, AK-47, MAC-11, and M4A1. These can be purchased in the Guns n optics n ammo shop in the frontrooms. Again, no microtransactions, just a highly requested feature bought with in-game money.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/b6cad5e396c549713e1ce177b92aa9c5d23958f6.png[/img]

[b]Added new balloon sounds[/b]

Our discord member @SherlockBuzti made three new balloon noises! And yes, it is an actual recording of a balloon popping.

[b]Buffed most entities[/b]

A lot of balancing changes have occurred this week. Previously, many entities that were quite large only took a few shots to disable. This is no longer the case. About 2/3s of the entities have been buffed to make each encounter feel like a real fight.

[b]Raised prices of many things[/b]

The shacks in Shack Storage, the building supplies in Moe's Building Supplies, and some other items have all gotten a bump.

[b]Rebalanced the clump wheel[/b]

The individual token payout sectors have been decreased from 10->6 and from 5->3. This is only the start of the clump wheel's long journey and shaping into a fair game element.

[b]Improved Smiler AI[/b]

Instead of chasing you around the map infinitely, Smilers now have a set radius where they disengage like most other entities. They aren't all-knowing any longer! They also engage at a shorter distance.

[b]Hardmode changes[/b]

For those who don't know, hard mode can be ticked on in settings when you're in the frontrooms. This gives a hardcore experience with all sorts of buffs/effects. Now, when you die in hard mode you'll get sent back to the frontrooms. Not only that, but the vault will now have limited quantity in hard mode!

[b]Added several new areas to the poolrooms[/b]

The 9-map poolrooms complex is here! Full of new and freshly revamped maps. A full list of maps is:

> (New) Poolrooms entrance area
> Sprawling poolrooms
> (New) Poolrooms showers
> (New) Water-filled desert
> Dark poolrooms
> Dead-end house
> Hotel pool
> Red poolrooms
> Dead-end pool neighborhood

[b]Added tons of new music and ambience[/b]

You can visit their Soundcloud at https://soundcloud.com/zerobladerising

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/fd205051ae5137922218430134a68c082a206616.png[/img]

This is the third iteration of the MEG base. Featuring all new entrance rooms, lounges, offices, and bathrooms, this iteration is quite expansive. All of the MEG features you know and love from the old base are still here. There are new NPCs and even an MEG cat!

[b]Revamped BNTG trader's vault[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/722b84a07012a397f7cfaa5e14f977d91922b8b5.png[/img]

The level 1 BNTG base is the largest base in-game! Featuring 12 shops and many other buildings, it contains all sorts of goodies to buy and sell. Now the base has gotten a graphical rework, with much more rubble and many more dirty surfaces. Canopies instead of cubic geometry, and trims instead of straight edges. The base as a whole is a bit darker now.

notes.title: V. 3.29, "Economical Expansion Update"
notes.content:
ATTENTION: If you haven't yet: go to BrVR's steam library page -> gear icon -> properties -> betas -> and opt into this update by selecting the beta branch. This is to reduce unwanted update downloads for people on the stable main branch.

[b]Revamped level 22[/b]

Level 22 has gotten a light revamp, putting more realistic rubble in place of rubble that comes out of no where. More dirt and grime leads to a more ruined atmosphere. In addition, many of the walls are now concrete, giving it a varied feel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/d023e8f2e241bb4be4484e59bce095ae0c05fe81.png[/img]

[b]Added Level 369[/b]

Back a few updates ago we added Level Theta. It was created by a member of our discord named Gatchi13. They did an awesome job sculpting the level in Unreal Engine and then we revised it and put it in-game. So, we did it again. In fact, anyone can submit their levels, as long as it meets our quality standards. Join our discord if you're interested!

Level 369, made by our discord user Dave, is based on the Backrooms Fandom version of the level. It's a large grassy complex of concrete halls, often talked about as "The Grassrooms". Calming wind chimes play in the background. There are three exits. One to level 9 via a key door, one to level 18 via a vine, and one to level 8 via a rocky area. There are physical windchimes that the player can interact with, and also physical vines that the player can crawl up. There are many fruits and foods as well scattered around the outskirts of the level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/33029b0bb84097925d244c2328e6e046c2928217.png[/img]

[b]Added...gun...skins?[/b]

It sounds like a dirty word these days, but I'll tell you, "no microtransactions, ma!"

Jokes aside, there are now 10 new gun skins in this first set for the AS-VAL, AKS-74U, AK-47, MAC-11, and M4A1. These can be purchased in the Guns n optics n ammo shop in the frontrooms. Again, no microtransactions, just a highly requested feature bought with in-game money.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/b6cad5e396c549713e1ce177b92aa9c5d23958f6.png[/img]

[b]Added new balloon sounds[/b]

Our discord member @SherlockBuzti made three new balloon noises! And yes, it is an actual recording of a balloon popping.

[b]Buffed most entities[/b]

A lot of balancing changes have occurred this week. Previously, many entities that were quite large only took a few shots to disable. This is no longer the case. About 2/3s of the entities have been buffed to make each encounter feel like a real fight.

[b]Raised prices of many things[/b]

The shacks in Shack Storage, the building supplies in Moe's Building Supplies, and some other items have all gotten a bump.

[b]Rebalanced the clump wheel[/b]

The individual token payout sectors have been decreased from 10->6 and from 5->3. This is only the start of the clump wheel's long journey and shaping into a fair game element.

[b]Improved Smiler AI[/b]

Instead of chasing you around the map infinitely, Smilers now have a set radius where they disengage like most other entities. They aren't all-knowing any longer! They also engage at a shorter distance.

[b]Hardmode changes[/b]

For those who don't know, hard mode can be ticked on in settings when you're in the frontrooms. This gives a hardcore experience with all sorts of buffs/effects. Now, when you die in hard mode you'll get sent back to the frontrooms. Not only that, but the vault will now have limited quantity in hard mode!

Now for some rapid-fire changes!

[b]Increased clump pull time
Fixed level 1's sports card trade-in
Sports cards can now be added to the inventory
Nerfed Taurus Raging Bull
Nerfed AK-47
Nerfed Mac-11
Fixed Level 13 entity pileup
Added the legacy museum to the normal hub
Fixed chicken sandwich hand positioner
Replaced poolrooms ladder
Moved showers and sinks in the poolrooms to be at a better height
Level 3999 challenges UX has been improved
Jumpscare achievement fixed[/b]

Join our discord: https://discord.gg/Px6jpjFEt6
A fun place to hang out! Plus, suggestions, bug reports, and more.

notes.title: V. 3.27, MAIN BRANCH UPDATE
notes.content:
[h1]This update is back on the main branch! If you are on the beta branch, you will also be updated to this version automatically.[/h1]

Here are some things that are new this week:

[b]Compressed over 200+ textures[/b]

Many textures now take up less space on your hard drive! This doesn't make much of an impact right now, however this newest update is around ~500MB smaller than V. 3.26.

[b]Compressed several large audio files[/b]

The Radio Ralph broadcasts and several of the meditation files have been compressed to save space. These took up an insane amount of space, up to 80MB for some large files!

[b]Added/replaced several door pictures[/b]

The pictures on doors for levels 7, 36, 46, and Level Critical have changed or been added.

[b]Revamped level negative 5's part 2[/b]

This area is more linear and much more spooky! Also, it is now full of props compared to the relative lack of them in the last version.

[h1][b]Now, if you were on the main branch you'll get a ton of other stuff from past beta updates:[/b][/h1]

[b]Revamped level 9[/b]

Level 9 has been completely redone! Level 9's streets have been completely redone, and so have the houses. The houses have been furnished more realistically, and there is now tons of new loot inside. Hounds infest the streets, and lurkers infest the woods. The neighborhood watch and the mangled still stalk the fields around the houses.

[b]Revamped level negative 4[/b]

Level negative 4 now has better lighting, more foliage, and increased view distance. Nothing else has changed with the layout of the level though.

[b]Revamped level negative 5[/b]

Level negative 5 has gotten a facelift. The sky, fog, and even the ground have gotten upgrades. It's still extremely cold!

[b]Revamped the woodrooms[/b]

The woodrooms have gotten an absolute overhaul, with all sorts of new rooms, props, and secrets. There are also some non-euclidean effects such as walls shifting.

[b]Fixed many picture achievements[/b]

The level 1 and 2 picture achievements have been fixed.

[b]Fixed a couple of bounty issues[/b]

Previously, the bounties on level 1 would rarely give you impossible objectives like shooting a smiler on level 21. This is now fixed.

[b]Moved the legacy museum to the hub[/b]

We thought it was too easter egg-ish to put in the frontrooms, so we moved it.

[b]Turned up radio backrooms station on radio[/b]

Self-Explanatory

[b]Added balloon popping physics[/b]

Balloons now whizz around the room when popped, and make a satisfying pop sound when out of air. The string can also be cut now.

[b]You can now buy meat in the level 5 casino for 125bb[/b]

Self-Explanatory

[b]Revamped level 8[/b]

Level 8 was completely rebuilt from scratch in this update! The revamp was inspired by the book Journey To The Center Of The Earth by Jules Verne. There are now all-new caves and rocks, plus a giant ocean in the middle of the areas. The graphics have been overhauled with higher-definition rocks and stalagmites. The gameplay is more vertical, allowing to go down large shafts and swim in water. Don't worry, the fights with the centipede and the large spider are still present.

[b]Added crafting material sales booths[/b]

In the frontrooms and level 1 there are now panels to sell crafting resources in bulk. A good way to make cash, and a way to incentivize the collection of crafting materials.

[b]Added new survivor tapes[/b]

A new tape (joining the 20+ others) by @SherlockBuzti is in-game in level 22. Plus, another new tape by @cameraman from our discord is in-game in level 480. Thank you both for your contribution!

[b]New songs[/b]

There are now 2 new songs in-game. The first is in the new level 8's ocean, and the second is in level 15. Suggested by @LunaNightZ on our discord.

[b]New entity: lurker[/b]

A 12ft tall creature is in the level 8 ocean now, he is slow and zombie-like however is quite creepy. He appears nowhere else, but he may in the future.

[b]Added music and a house to level 999[/b]
[b]Changed faceling behaviour[/b]
[b]Added more props to level 15[/b]
[b]Removed exit doors from back of tutorial[/b]
[b]Added new departure signs to level 36[/b]
[b]Reduced the amount of ammo in supply chests[/b]
[b]Added new locations for Chaze's Guns and Supplies + ChawMP's Produce[/b]
[b]Moved casino mini-pawn machine further towards the clump wheel[/b]

notes.title: V. 3.23, MAIN BRANCH UPDATE
notes.content:
[h1]This update is back on the main branch! If you are on the beta branch, you will also be updated to this version automatically.[/h1]

Here are some things that are new this week:

[b]Added Toz-106 shotgun[/b]

A strange Russian bolt-action magazine-fed shotgun taking 4-round magazines. It is chambered in 20 gauge. It can be found on level 1020, the Soviet town, as it is quite fitting there. Model created by @K0SAME on our discord.

[b]Added procedural sections to Level Critical[/b]

Level Critical now has a few procedurally generated sections down a dark hallway. These sections lead to level 6 through a door.

[b]Revamped Level 3999[/b]

Level 3999 is dark now with more neon lights and a purple theming. Some of the old-looking props have been replaced with new ones. This is ongoing and will be improved even further in the next update on the beta branch.

[b]Added Dave's Shaves to level 36[/b]

We have a longstanding tradition of giving our discord community their own stores in-game. So in this update we've added Dave's Shaves, a neat place to change your avatar. Suggested by @Dave on our discord.

[b]Improved tutorial starting room[/b]

This room now features trash on the floor, a wooden doorframe for the exit, and a few other pieces of furniture.

[h1][b]Now, if you were on the main branch you'll get a ton of other stuff from past beta updates:[/b][/h1]

[b]Added Level Critical[/b]

A very sprawling level with several sections. It all starts on a street, and you can go into a building which slowly degrades into rubble. There are many explorable paths and exits, even recreations of other levels like level RUN and level 41. There are also many secret areas, items, and side-areas to get lost in. There is a lot of verticality, with ladders in many sections. Suggested by @keeper on our discord server.

[b]Kitty now stalks you in level 974[/b]

As the name suggests, kitty will now teleport when you aren't looking at him. This has scared me, and I suspect it will scare you all too.

[b]Revamped level 480[/b]

Practically every single room in level 480 has been redone with new props and vibes. A lot of pillars have been added, and low-quality models have been replaced in favor of higher-quality counterparts.

[b]Revamped level run[/b]

Many trims and lights have been added to level run alongside many other smaller graphical adjustments. Suggested by @clouddealer on our discord server.

[b]Revamped purgatory[/b]

Many of purgatory's rooms have been greatly improved with more props and smoother lighting.

[b]Added more rooms to level 19[/b]

Added a couple of very rarely spawning rooms like a room chaulk full of vents. Suggested by @LunanightZ on our discord server.

[b]Reduced the amount of entities in level 188[/b]

Now there are four entities on the level instead of an absolute entity spam. This really does help the atmosphere.

[b]Added Gatchi's chip factory[/b]

This factory uses a very suspicious device called a "potatinator" to chop potatos into chips. Made in honor of @gatchi13 on our discord server.

[b]Added Tired Crusader's skin insurance[/b]

There is now a sign for "Tired Crusader Skin Insurance" on the skin insurance billboard in levels 9/11. Made in honor of @tired_crusader on our discord server.

[b]Added another Tiny to level 7[/b]

Sometimes people were avoiding Tiny altogether while in level 7. This is now fixed by adding another Tiny to the alternate path.

[b]Changed air horn noise[/b]

It's now much louder and "deep fried" instead of the wimpy air horn previously.

[b]Changed level 0 wallpaper colors[/b]

Probably the largest change and this update's namesake. The walls in level 0 are now bright green, the ceiling tiles are beige, and the carpet is tan. The colors are now much more accurate to the original picture. Previously, the colors were much more yellow and brown.

[b]Revamped level 4[/b]

Level 4 has recieved a facelift! The wall, floor, and ceiling textures have been changed, along with many other textures in the level. Trims have been added to almost all of the walls, and they have turned black. More props have filled rooms, and the lighting has become softer. The ambient light level has been increased. Broad windows and more single windows have been added, giving even more light. Small paper scatter has also been added to finish out the revamp. Suggested by Clouddealer on our discord.

[b]Added wooden frames to windows[/b]

Small wooden frames have been given to the sanity-draining windows. This does not change the overall size of the level.

[b]Added more scatter to levels[/b]

Some subtle scattered rocks and paper have been added to a couple of levels. More will be added in future updates, but for now this only affects levels 4 and 8.

[b]Added more props to level 974[/b]

Level 974 has recieved many more props and pieces of furniture to deck out nearly every room. Also, there are now actual light fictures on the ceiling where those were missing previously

[b]Added concertina[/b]

A nice instrument. Plays one of three sounds when the trigger button is pressed. It can be found in level 11's radio studio. Suggested on our discord server by Gatchi13

[b]Added player piano[/b]

A piano that plays music and can be found in level 3's MEG outpost.

[b]Updated the rave room[/b]

notes.title: V. 3.22 "Mass Level Revamp update"
notes.content:
ATTENTION: Go to BrVR's steam library page -> gear icon -> properties -> betas -> and opt into this update by selecting the beta branch. This is to reduce unwanted update downloads.

[b]Added Level Critical[/b]

A very sprawling level with several sections. It all starts on a street, and you can go into a building which slowly degrades into rubble. There are many explorable paths and exits, even recreations of other levels like level RUN and level 41. There are also many secret areas, items, and side-areas to get lost in. There is a lot of verticality, with ladders in many sections. Suggested by @keeper on our discord server.

[b]Kitty now stalks you in level 974[/b]

As the name suggests, kitty will now teleport when you aren't looking at him. This has scared me, and I suspect it will scare you all too.

[b]Revamped level 480[/b]

Practically every single room in level 480 has been redone with new props and vibes. A lot of pillars have been added, and low-quality models have been replaced in favor of higher-quality counterparts.

[b]Revamped level run[/b]

Many trims and lights have been added to level run alongside many other smaller graphical adjustments. Suggested by @clouddealer on our discord server.

[b]Revamped purgatory[/b]

Many of purgatory's rooms have been greatly improved with more props and smoother lighting.

[b]Added more rooms to level 19[/b]

Added a couple of very rarely spawning rooms like a room chaulk full of vents. Suggested by @LunanightZ on our discord server.

[b]Reduced the amount of entities in level 188[/b]

Now there are four entities on the level instead of an absolute entity spam. This really does help the atmosphere.

[b]Added Gatchi's chip factory[/b]

This factory uses a very suspicious device called a "potatinator" to chop potatos into chips. Made in honor of @gatchi13 on our discord server.

[b]Added Tired Crusader's skin insurance[/b]

There is now a sign for "Tired Crusader Skin Insurance" on the skin insurance billboard in levels 9/11. Made in honor of @tired_crusader on our discord server.

[b]Added another Tiny to level 7[/b]

Sometimes people were avoiding Tiny altogether while in level 7. This is now fixed by adding another Tiny to the alternate path.

[b]Changed air horn noise[/b]

It's now much louder and "deep fried" instead of the wimpy air horn previously.

notes.title: V. 3.21 "Color Palette Update"
notes.content:
ATTENTION: Go to BrVR's steam library page -> gear icon -> properties -> betas -> and opt into this update by selecting the beta branch. This is to reduce unwanted update downloads.

[b]Changed level 0 wallpaper colors[/b]

Probably the largest change and this update's namesake. The walls in level 0 are now bright green, the ceiling tiles are beige, and the carpet is tan. The colors are now much more accurate to the original picture. Previously, the colors were much more yellow and brown.

[b]Revamped level 4[/b]

Level 4 has recieved a facelift! The wall, floor, and ceiling textures have been changed, along with many other textures in the level. Trims have been added to almost all of the walls, and they have turned black. More props have filled rooms, and the lighting has become softer. The ambient light level has been increased. Broad windows and more single windows have been added, giving even more light. Small paper scatter has also been added to finish out the revamp. Suggested by Clouddealer on our discord.

[b]Added wooden frames to windows[/b]

Small wooden frames have been given to the sanity-draining windows. This does not change the overall size of the level.

[b]Added more scatter to levels[/b]

Some subtle scattered rocks and paper have been added to a couple of levels. More will be added in future updates, but for now this only affects levels 4 and 8.

[b]Added more props to level 974[/b]

Level 974 has recieved many more props and pieces of furniture to deck out nearly every room. Also, there are now actual light fictures on the ceiling where those were missing previously

notes.title: V. 3.19 "Level 44 update"
notes.content:
[b]Added level 44[/b]

A sprawling retail complex level. Level 44 contains two different areas, the stores and the back areas. The stores have orange walls and bare shelves with store closing signs on the ceiling. The back areas have brick walls, machinery, and some resources scattered around. There are also some rare occurances, like finding rooms that have red lights or a room that has a strange electrical noise. The only entities are skin-stealers. Level 44 uses the infinite generation algorithm.

[b]Added door pictures to levels 44, 163, 250, 370, 422[/b]

These should fill in some of the doors with no pictures in the hub. I will do more soon.

[b]Added rarely-spawning rooms to level FUN[/b]

There are two new room types you can find in level FUN. The first is a set of hallways with fences barricading the ends, blood spatter everywhere, and a metal roof. The second is a room like all of the other party rooms, except it contains supplies housed in chests.

[b]Added new year event[/b]

The new year's ball drop is BACK! Once it becomes midnight, the ball will drop and Srooc Light will fall from the sky. There will also be big "2024" text this year.

[b]Varied bullet hole decals[/b]

There are now four different bullet hole decal variants for small-caliber weapons.

[b]Fixed 870 BCG clipping[/b]

The bolt carrier group of the 870 shotgun would clip into the back of the gun. This is now fixed.

[b]Added LODs to skin-stealers[/b]

Since skin-stealers don't really need to be high-detailed at all times, LODs have been added to improve performance.

[b]Added tick delay for enemies[/b]

All enemies now have a delay for any scripts they perform every tick. This also increases performance.

[b]Added a BCG to the g28 rifle[/b]

It didn't have one, so now it does. This means you can use the bolt release that was already implemented for the M4A1

[b]Fixed some visual issues with doors[/b]

Since doors got resized in the last update, there were several visual breaks with extra doors and text attached to no-clip-a-matics. These should be fixed.

[b]Fixed greenrooms door picture[/b]

Previously, it wouldn't render. Now it does!

Happy new year everybody! 2024 will be bright as ever, and we plan to continue improving the game and adding new features in 2024.

notes.title: V. 3.18 "The small QOL update"
notes.content:
[b]Added a weird sideways staircase level to level 370[/b]

A secret sublevel has been added to level 370! This level is merely a dark version of level 998's staircase, but turned 90 degrees on its side. Very trippy.

[b]Added a christmas tree and wreath to the frontrooms[/b]

It's the christmas season. In the last update we made partygoers wear hats, and now we bring more christmas decor. This will be the last week to access it!

[b]Removed level 4 brick spam[/b]

This was a strange feature where you could shoot a spot on level 4's wall to get bricks. This has been removed.

[b]Turned up level 7 voiceline's volume[/b]

Previously, it was very silent. This is fixed.

[b]Added haptics to many objects[/b]

Revolvers, lighters, torches, glowsticks, and other items now have haptics for interaction.

[b]Made doors slightly taller[/b]

Doors used to be around the player's standing height, now they are taller.

[b]Added a resubmit button to the questionaire[/b]

Once you submit the questionaire in the tutorial, there is now a resubmit button that you can press.

[b]Scrap gun now needs to have the ejector pulled open[/b]

The scrap gun seemed to be too simple to operate. Now, you have to pull open the ejector, increasing reload time.

[b]Improved sandbox item menu hit detection[/b]

Selecting items on the sandbox item menu is no longer as buggy.

[b]Lessened the cooldown between changing channels on the radio[/b]

Self-explanatory

notes.title: V. 3.17 "The Hidden Rooms Update"
notes.content:
[b]Added Red Room Radios[/b]

In this new update, there are now many red rooms you can find throughout the backrooms. These always are crammed with props or rubble, and have a single radio sitting on a table. When turned on, the radio will play any number of creepy sounds depending on what level you're on. These can be found in levels 2, 3, 15, 22, 25, 33, and more.

[b]Revamped level 9.1[/b]

This fixes the specularity of the rocks, adds a ton of rubble, and adjusts fog. Pretty basic changes but it really changes the feel of the sublevel.

[b]Added back alleys to level 15[/b]

The large open spaces in level 15 have been replaced with even more cramped corridors. Even though they're far away from the spawn where most of the lights are, these spaces are still lit.

[b]OOB no-clip[/b]

If a player reaches -300,000 centimeters below the floor of the level, the level will restart. So, if you fall out of the map this will help.

[b]Added sounds to level 40 minigames[/b]

The button to start them now plays a little beep, plus the turrets in General Starflare's Entity Mowdown now play a firing noise.

[b]Added shadows to level 18[/b]

This change adds a lot of depth to the level! Also, I changed the colors up a bit, now the sky is a bit more purple.

[b]Added partygoer santa hats[/b]

It's Christmastime in the backrooms, and the partygoers are showing up with all sorts of jolly greetings such as a tooth-filled arm to the face.

[b]Fixed some z-fighting in level 36 [/b]

A small change that fixes some texture flickering with the doors to the parking garage.

notes.title: V. 3.16 "The attachment overhaul update"
notes.content:
[b]Overhauled gun attachments[/b]

Now, one tap with the screwdriver will activate the attachment, then you can tap again to change it from a red dot to a laser to a scope. This makes attachments simpler and you don't have to worry about losing them through levels since you can just re-apply them!

[b]Added a new radio show to the portable radio[/b]

This one features Radio Ralph ranting about skin-stealers and his way to work, then capping it off with a nice musical number. The runtime is around 5 minutes. It is also available on youtube, the video is named "Radio Ralph Backrooms Radio Excerpt".

[b]Added a new area and exit to level 20[/b]

Now you can jump over the wall near the loading bay to gain access to a back area with a bunch of rooms.  The door there in the back gets you to level 21.

[b]Revamped level 23[/b]

Now the level has a ceiling made of ground with huge upside-down trees. There's also 2 new glow rooms, each are snaking complexes full of rooms and treasure. There's also a new exit that leads to level 46.

[b]Added a hand cannon[/b]

A simple craftable weapon capable of firing one very heavy round, and that's it. Once it's fired, it's fired. Carry 3-4 for best results. Suggested by Gatchi13 on our discord server.

[b]Changed some firing sounds[/b]

Shotgun firing now has a boomier sound, and the m1 garand's firing sound is also much punchier.

[b]Changed 1887 shotgun shell animation[/b]

The shells inside the gun will now correctly animate to display the state of how much ammo is inside of the gun.

[b]Fixed fatal error on level 94[/b]

You would spawn in the sky with no way to get down, this is fixed.

A simple craftable weapon capable of firing one very heavy round, and that's it. Once it's fired, it's fired. Carry 3-4 for best results. Suggested by Gatchi13 on our discord server.

tags.balance_change: Shotgun firing now has a boomier sound, and the m1 garand's firing sound is also much punchier.

tags.bug: You would spawn in the sky with no way to get down, this is fixed.

notes.title: V. 3.15 "The DIY Update"
notes.content:
[b]Redid crafting[/b]

There are now over 10 different crafting materials, all able to be stored in an ammo pouch-like system. These materials now show up on the crafting table UI and crafting is simply a button press. Much more fluid and much better than the old system. Also, it is more polished in many areas.

[b]Added crafting material drops in many levels[/b]

You will now see crafting materials in many levels such as 2, 3, 9, 20, and others. Those levels I've listed are hotspots, but many crafting materials are available in other levels too.

[b]Added brass knuckles + dagger[/b]

No, they aren't two separate items. You can now craft brass knuckles that have a dagger attached already, and it is much more powerful than the standard ones.

[b]Added brick on a stick[/b]

It's literally a brick affixed to a fire axe handle. It does a good bit of damage and has a large hitbox. It even allows you to do ledge clambering, similar to the game "Getting Over it". However, it is also very heavy and unwieldy.

[b]Added scrap gun[/b]

A single shot 7.62x51 rifle made out of assorted metal and screws. It is relatively simple though, once you put the bullet in the slide automatically goes forward and once you shoot it automatically thrusts back, ejecting the round.

[b]Added scrap gun auto[/b]

A 9mm version of the gun above. It also fires from an open bolt and is very unwieldy. It is very similar to the Mac-11 SMG.

[b]Added scrap flashlight[/b]

A flashlight with very bad efficiency and a scrappy appearance. The battery wears out twice as fast compared to the normal flashlight.

[b]Added scrap crowbar[/b]

It's a plain, grey crowbar but with a knife affixed to the curved end for extra damage. Also has a very large damage hitbox compared the the normal crowbar.

[b]Added punching[/b]

Ever found yourself in a really sticky situation and you didn't bring adequate weaponry? Maybe that longsword is just out of reach? Well, now you can just punch the entity! Note that punching does very little damage and is generally only a last-ditch "defense". Suggested by Gatchi13 on discord.

[b]Fixed a weird bug with head gore[/b]

While facelings played their scream animation, it turns out that if their head exploded they would bug out instead of dying properly. This is fixed.

[b]Added sideways recoil to Mac-11[/b]

This simple changes increases the SMG's spread without being too terribly obtrusive. It also reduces the long-range potential of the weapon.

[b]Rebalanced certain stashes[/b]

Some stashes have loot added/removed from them compared to when they were first added.

[b]Added physical bolt release to m4a1[/b]

A fun feature for realism. Now, once you're done firing the bolt will lock open just like on the real gun, and you can press the bolt release to send the bolt flying forward, picking up another round. Alternatively, you can just pull the charging handle.

[b]Changed magazines for m4a1, ak47, aks74u to all have 30 rounds[/b]

Self-explanatory

[b]Made the mk3 bolt more accurate to irl[/b]

The bolt handle moves now, but the piece behind it now remains at a net 0 rotation.

[b]Made the killshack mini range longer[/b]

I've made it longer, added walls on both sides, and staggered the targets so that you can do some longer-range shots!

[b]Removed assault rifles from levels[/b]

Many AK-47's and M4A1's have been removed from levels. As we've always said, we're constantly shaping the game to lean less on piles of guns and more on bought/crafted/scavenged guns. Pro tip: if you want an AK-47, then your best bet is to go to Shadow Tactics on level 1's BNTG base.

[b]Simplified ammo pouch[/b]

Small change, the ammo pouch now counts ammo in terms of small and large ammo compared to how it was originally (it counted every magazine separately). This is really big for me, so I can add things to the ammo pouch system without excess hassle. This also effects ammo making, so you can craft small and large ammo now. This does not effect shotguns or grenade launchers, and you will continue to be able to use all of the shells you love.

[b]Blued Russian ammo correctly[/b]

Russian ammunition (7.62x25, 7.62x39, 5.45x39) was not correctly colored. This is fixed, giving the rounds a greenish hue with more orange lead.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
This hotfix includes two things:

[b]Redo of vault changes[/b]

In the latest update, the vault was changed from infinitely spawning items to having a set quantity. We got a multitude of people from our steam community and our discord server saying that it was a bad change, so we have listened to all of you and reverted that change! I don't believe this should have any impact on your vault's save data, it should only affect the spawning/saving of items.

[b]Gun sound changes[/b]

The G28 and M4A1 rifles now both have a new charging handle grab/release noise. This noise is much more realistic as it was recorded from a very similar gun in real life!

notes.title: V. 3.14 "Frontrooms Sweet Frontrooms update"
notes.content:
[b]Added youtube to the frontrooms TV[/b]

You can now browse youtube while sitting on your couch eating fried chicken. Two caveats: It loads quite slowly, and there isn't really a search function. But, you can still totally watch some content!

[b]Made the frontrooms computer functional[/b]

The frontrooms computer now has the same script as The End's computer does. This means the computer can turn on/off, restart, launch applications, access the start menu, etc.

[b]Items in vault cannot spawn infinitely now[/b]

A big change! Now, if you put one item in, you get one item out. This helps balence a lot of the game, as if you have an M4A1 and lose it, it's gone for good now! (Unless of course you go back to exactly where you died).

[b]Added an adapter to the frontrooms computer that allows you to read notebook notes[/b]

The notebook is a small, cramped interface for reading the notes you have gathered, so now you can press a button on the frontrooms computer to go into a note viewer. You can see all of the notes you've gathered and put into your notebook!

[b]Added Level Theta[/b]

Our first user-created level made by Gatchi13. It's an aquarium level, with many glass enclosures and many corridors. There is also a long ramp that leads from the top of the level to the very bottom. Off of that twisting and turning ramp, there are many hallways which lead into rooms like galleries, shrines, pools, and more. There's also an office room at the top and a mysterious shipping container maze near the bottom. If you adventure far enough into this level (it's huge!) you can even find a long-lost locomotive. We applaud Gatchi13 for creating this level and we hope that other user-created levels will be added in the future!

[b]Added more rubble to level 22[/b]

Self-explanatory. Level 22 was supposed to be a destroyed car park, and it is indeed now a destroyed car park.

[b]Added stashes to The Mountain Village[/b]

The Mountain Village was such a linear level, and now I've spiced it up with a good few areas outside of the main valley. Those being a stash, and a random loot area.

[b]Added more detail to levels negative 6 and negative 8[/b]

In level negative 6 there is now more cinder-block rubble and props. In level negative 8 there are now more rocks coating the walls and less rigid architecture.

notes.title: V. 3.13 "The lost treasure update"
notes.content:
[b]Added stashes to levels[/b]

These bits of lost treasure are tucked away in unlikely places on many different levels of the backrooms! They contain a gun, an item case, and a note from whoever left the stash. These stashes can be found in a multitude of levels! They are often very hidden though.

[b]Added random loot cases full of money[/b]

These new loot crates look like yellow versions of the item crates, but they have 3000 backrooms bucks worth of cash inside of them. They randomly spawn in levels such as 2, 3, 5, and 13. Generally they spawn more in more mazelike levels.

[b]Added new money stack[/b]

This money stack feels good to hold because it's 10 100bb bills stuck together! These are found in the cases mentioned prior.

[b]You can store money with trigger now[/b]

Money can be pocketed into your wallet now by just pressing trigger in a similar way to adding ammo to your ammo pouch.

[b]Tutorialized money[/b]

Money now has a small section at the very end of the tutorial where it shows you what money looks like and how to store it.

[b]Replaced the death and damage noises[/b]

The "UUGGGGHH" noise has been replaced with lighter grunts for small damage and bigger ones for death. Suggested by Grimnee on our discord server.

[b]Added We've got Skin to Quarter Life[/b]

The fourth chapter of Fordon Greeman's adventures continues with We've got Skin. A pretty long chapter taking place in a storage facility. It is currently unfinished though, I will work on it soon.

[b]Added a bucket of chicken to backrooms burger[/b]

A bucket of KFC-style chicken, what else could you ask for? Deep fried and boiled with no artifical flavors. Suggested by Dave on our discord server.

[b]Revamped level 3[/b]

Level 3 got an absolute facelift. The layout remained the same, however all of the materials on the walls and floors changed. There is now cinder block rubble, trims, and other embellishments. It really looks decrepit now!

[b]Removed Bow + Arrow from tutorial[/b]

Simple change. It was fairly janky and we didn't want to highlight it in the tutorial.

notes.title: V. 3.12
notes.content:
[b]Redid backpack[/b]

A big change many people have suggested on our discord server. The backpack has been replaced with a better model and a new system for storing/receiving items. Instead of having six slots, you can now store an infinite number of things in there free-form. This is inspired by Into The Radius and Ghosts of Tabor. If you've played either, you know what I mean.

[b]Added level 36[/b]

A sprawling airport with two concourses and many exits. There are shops, gates, back areas, kitchens, lounges, restaurants, and tons of other explorable areas. You start in concourse A where everthing is eerily clean, and you can explore there and find loot. In concourse A, there are around 10 gates and no entities. Then, you can make the journey to concourse B which is crumbling and delapitated. There are entities in concourse B, and a similar amount of explorable area to concourse A.

[b]Items now persist in hands[/b]

If you're taking items from level to level, items will now persist that are in your hands. Pretty simple change.

[b]Educated about backpack in tutorial[/b]

Added some tutorial text showing how to enable the backpack and where it is placed on your back once enabled.

[b]Added an exit to the level creator[/b]

The "Level Creator" map in the Devrooms didn't have a conventional exit, so I added one. It leads to level 15 as of now.

[b]Added gun cases[/b]

These cases are now scattered around and replace actual weapons. They contain a gun and some ammunition. They are openable and now have a small space in the tutorial for them.

[b]Added item cases[/b]

These cases are scattered around levels of the backrooms and contain various items. Some cases include money, some include ammunition, some include other things.

[b]Redid ambient noises[/b]

The ambient noises that would randomly jumpscare you (while seeming to scare the daylights out of players) needed a rework. So, now they are much more subtle and build a sense of unease instead of a jumpscare.

[b]Added Beretta M9 pistol[/b]

A solid 15-round 9mm pistol. Now I wonder which is better out of the five pistols? This gun was suggested by Chaze on discord.

[b]Added cinder block rubble in some places[/b]

In level 2 especially, there are now patches of rubble made up of cinder blocks to add to the dismal mood.

[b]Added more exposed rebar[/b]

Also mostly in level 2, there is some more exposed rebar in various areas of the halls.

notes.title: V. 2.68 (One year anniversary on Steam!)
notes.content:
Hello BrVRers! Yesterday was our 1 year anniversary on Steam. Thank you all for an amazing year, and amazing feedback on the game.

[b]Added the integrated workbench[/b]

Essentially, the integrated workbench has a crafting table, upgrading bench, brewer, ammo maker, vault, and a furnace all in one! You kind find these setups at level 1's base alpha, at level 2's base, and in a couple of other isolated locations.

[b]Improved upgrading and crafting[/b]

Upgrading now has a UI to go along with it. It shows you recipes, and has a button to upgrade instead of automatically doing it. There are also 5 new upgrades for guns you can get! Remember to save them in your vault! The upgrades are as follows: A mac-11 with a muzzle brake for better recoil management, a 1911 with full-auto, an 870 with a 9 round tube, an m4 shotgun with a full choke, and a normal 870 (upgraded from the short 870).

[b]Added level 0.01[/b]

As part of the infinitely generated level 0, level 0.01 stands as a "chunkier" area with fatter walls and longer hallways. Everything else is the same though.

[b]Added a new mesh for the vault[/b]

Instead of being a blue hot tub-esque device, it is now a square tub with a vault door on top and a level 0 wallpaper signifying that items no-clip out of the vault when they are spawned.

[b]Improved the terror hotel casino[/b]

Added more than one big green button, moved some floating text, removed a stray mirror, and added some subtitles for certain things.

[b]A lot of small bug fixes[/b]

Some with the terror hotel casino, others with shelves, and others with the level 4 ladder area.

A bonus change: due to some technical glitches we were forced to rebuild the level 28, level 1020, level 201, and level 7 landscape materials from scratch. They mostly look the same as before, but the colors may be off in some areas. In addition, some pitch-black areas may form, but those will be taken care of shortly. I haven't found any myself, but they may be out there.

Thanks to all of our OGs who have stuck it out with us since before launch, and have since been with us through this amazing year. If you would like to shape the game please join our discord, and if you're enjoying the game (or not) leave a steam review with your thoughts. Thanks for reading, goodbye.

notes.title: V. 2.64
notes.content:
Hello BrVRers! All kinds of new stuff today!

[b]Did tons of optimization changes[/b]

Level 0, Level 1, Level 3, Level 4, Level 7, Level 8, Level 20, Level 23, Level 26, Level 27, Level 28, Level 31, Level 2Two, Level FUN, Level The End, Devrooms, Level 1020, Level 201, and Level -4 have all gotten sizeable optimization. This comes from LODs for meshes, distance culling, less complex materials, taking out some objects and entities that are causing spikes, and other optimization methods too numerous to name here.

[b]Added a BNTG base to level 2[/b]

Added BNTG Base Railway, a base with a main hallway branching into two separate large rooms. The rooms have scattered props and furniture, and were just thrown together by the BNTG crew around their rail system in the area.

[b]Added a secret partygoer sound (1-500 chance)[/b]

This noise was cut (with permission) from one of our playtester's videos of them singing a song. At the end, a "Hee Hee" is heard. So, the natural thing to do is make an easter egg out of it.

[b]Revamped level 37[/b]

Level 37 got a glow-up with all new landscaping, better quality plants, and some other features. Jerry is much slower, so he won't spawnkill you, and the entire level has been optimized.

[b]Revamped level FUN's lighting[/b]

Level FUN is darker and less saturated in color now, with better optimization to boot. A few less partygoers though, there are 7 instead of the previous 14.

[b]Better Beverly Room and Boiler Room[/b]

The Beverly Room now has new trims on the walls and a new wall blocking access to the elevators, the boiler room has new machines and pipes as well. Also, there have been some subtle changes to the rest of level 5 like new wallpaper and trims.

[b]Made some changes to Quarter Life[/b]

Small UX changes like the skin reactor button lighting up, and some bug fixes like the water not being solid in Skin Complex.

[b]Added pipe noises to level 2[/b]

Some water-rushing-through-pipes noises has been added to many of the pipes in level 2 near spawn.

[b]Added more filing cabinets and windows to level 4[/b]

Self-explanatory

Bye BrVRers! A Level 19 revamp is on the way along with a ton of other goodies, so stay tuned! [i]*cough* infinite generation *cough*[/i]

notes.title: V. 2.62
notes.content:
Hello BrVRers!

This is a quick patch for a bug that one of our playtesters was having where upon entering the frontrooms, they would be stuck inside a cupboard. Funny bug I know, however it needed fixing. I was not able to replicate the issue, however I couldn't say for sure who else was having the issue so I pushed a patch.

There are a couple of other things though:

[b]- Added a new item: Crate keys[/b]

These keys are scattered around the lower levels and can be used to unlock the orange and blue crates. They can be found lying around in obscure places, however they can also be bought at some locations.

[b]- Added many props to level 11[/b]

Added dumpsters, streetlights, trash bins, newspaper dispensers, mailboxes, fences, gates, corrugated fences, caution barriers, barrels, street barriers, and more. Also, the render distance is slightly increased for some buildings.

[b]Made the shelves in level 4 more intuitive[/b]

The shelves inside chaze's guns and supplies now have a prop showing what the kiosk on the shelf is for.

[b]M1 garand bolt can be pulled regardless of open state[/b]

I have legitimately no idea why you'd want to waste a bullet doing this, put you can now. Yay realism.

And that's it for today! Bye!

notes.title: V. 2.61
notes.content:
Hello BrVRers!

[b]Made a new disclaimer screen[/b]

This new screen lets you choose between 5 options on a piece of paper. Whether you'd like to see entities, hallucinations, firearms, avatars, and blood. This also introduces a pen item. The secret area behind the wall is still there for anybody wondering.

[b]Added more lights to level 0[/b]

Level 0 is much brighter now. Many more lights have been added, and the overall light level has been buffed considerably.

[b]Added a new level7dark[/b]

Level 7 dark has been redone, adding more red fog and many more entities! This level is quite difficult to complete, since the visibility gets lower the farther you go down. At the end, it's essentially a maze with the thing on level 7 chasing you.

[b]Added some new rooms to level 33[/b]

Added some rooms reminiscent of GM_Mallparking. In addition to that, the parking lot area has been revamped a good bit, adding pipes on the ceiling and more detail. Plus, there is now better screen space ambient occlusion.

[b]Improved the elevator map[/b]

More reflections and better geometry, plus the mirror is the correct aspect ratio. Not much else really.

[b]Made an alternate fire mode for the double barrel shotgun[/b]

Pressing and holding trigger on the hand holding the foregrip whilst firing will fire both barrels at once. This can be done with both the long and sawn-off versions of the shotgun.

[b]Reduced recoil on the double barrel shotgun[/b]

The recoil has been reduced 50% on the long double barrel and 25% on the sawn-off variant.

[b]Randomized some walls and the spawn point of level 0[/b]

There are now three possible spawn points, and many walls are randomized near the starting area. It gets more normal as you go out from the middle.

[b]Buffed the flashlight[/b]

The flashlight has been buffed 25%, and the throw of the light has been enhanced by 50%. 

That's all for today! Some big bug fixes coming in the next one!

notes.title: V. 2.60
notes.content:
Hello BrVRers! Small update today, I have a lot of other stuff going on.

[b]Added new music to level 21[/b]

It's rather slow, plodding ballroom music similar to that of level 5. The music decreases in volume the farther away from the starting room you get.

[b]Added new music to level 571 part 4[/b]

This is similar to the arena mode music as in it's choppiness. It accompanies the strange vibe of level 571's forth part.

[b]Optimized and improved mipmaps in the frontrooms[/b]

I improved mipmaps on some pictures, wooden floor textures, and appliances. I also crushed some more meshes, leading to higher framerates. Hopefully this should fix most lag in there.

[b]Added more props to the siderooms[/b]

Added some crates, palettes, barrels, and other stacks of junk. I also replaced the low quality door mesh with a much higher quality one.

[b]Lightened up the dark areas of level 40[/b]

Now you can get lost in the endless arcade machine mania! There isn't anything playable back there, but it plays more into the liminal space aspect of the level. Which leads to...

[b]Removed clump bowling[/b]

It's old, it's janky, and it's cruel to the clumps! Nobody used it, and nobody liked it, so we took it out. We may add more to this level in the future to compensate for the lack of space now. We may even reopen that section as something different.

notes.title: V. 2.59
notes.content:
Hello BrVRers! (The few of you remaining)

[b]The backpack is a settings option[/b]

It's off be default, turn it on in the gameplay settings. This is to reduce jank for new players.

[b]Added brass knuckles, a melee weapon[/b]

Brass knuckles can be found, they don't do a ton of damage but are great for partygoer fistfights! Combine with a tommy gun to get the full gangsta experience.

[b]Deleted external deer from level 62[/b]

No more confusion, they're finally gone! The deer minigame is now the only occurrence of deer in the level.

[b]Added new music[/b]

There are two new tracks to play on the radio in levels 2-3. Both are piano-only tracks. Fun fact: the one that plays in level 3 was ripped from a song I made 5 years ago!

[b]Added many new areas to level 2[/b]

Added another water area like level 2.1, some more corridors, some areas with pillars and more pipes generally in the level.

[b]Added many new areas to level 4[/b]

Added a room with brighter lights, and a darker area. Both are on the outskirts of the level and contain no additional entities.

[b]Updated Chaze's Guns and Supplies[/b]

The banners on the walls of the level 4 location have a partygoer design on them. In addition, there is now a donation counter that gets fuller when you buy things. Once it's full it'll unlock a skin-stealer homeless shelter on level 3.

[b]Added many new areas to level 3[/b]

A recreation of the wikidot "out of bounds" picture has been added in addition to some more corridors and walkways.

[b]Added many new areas to level 13[/b]

Added some back hallways, 6 new explorable apartment areas, more white hallways, a room with one arcade machine in the corner (and a lore note), some hallways connecting already existing sections, and finally a back section to the level 7 entrance.

[b]Reduced linear/angular damping[/b]

The PPSh-41 and 1911 now have no linear or angular damping, meaning that they are free to go anywhere in your hands. By consequence, they don't fall slowly any longer.

[b]Changed tech tree order[/b]

The As Val and Mac-10 have swapped places on the arena tech tree. Suggested by SherlockBuzti.

And that's it! Now just to beat up some partygoers... Bye!

notes.title: V. 2.54
notes.content:
Welcome back BrVRers!

[b]Redid walking, running, and climbing physics[/b]

There's more acceleration when walking, turns are more sharp, and climbing is stabilized. Also, there is less bounciness on the body.

[b]Added another mile to Level RUN[/b]

This one features light rings, "knockdownable" doors, a cave section, and a surprise ending. There are also some fixes for level RUN's obstacles. Previously, you could sidestep a few that you can't now.

[b]Completely reworked the wrist communicators[/b]

The player now has two wristwatches instead of the MEG wrist communicators. The amount of features is pared back considerably, allowing you to only see your wallet, MEG exits, current time, and current level.

[b]Added some foliage to level 94[/b]

Ah yes, the tranquil animated kingdom. There's now some grass, and trees, and trees, and grass, and you get the picture.

[b]Added the m16 rifle[/b]

A classic military rifle now put to use in the backrooms. Its high fire rate and damage make it effective, but it does have a good deal of recoil.

[b]Added the Vector SMG[/b]

You might think that this is a Kriss Vector, but no! It's a "Casino Chris" vector, based on a popular skin-stealer. You can find this low-recoil smg in the level 5 casino, alongside Chris.

[b]Added some new areas to level 188[/b]

A few new rooms, mostly hotel rooms but also some hallways. The lighting has been improved here as well, and there are fewer entities. Another new addition is an outlook to the "outdoors" of level 188.

[b]Added the M1A rifle[/b]

This 30-round marauder is very similar to the M1 Garand, but grey. It makes its home in arena mode only as of now.

[b]Fixed some incorrect footstep noises[/b]

Stepping on some carpets would play the concrete footstep sound, and stepping on some wood floors would play the carpet footstep sound. This is now fixed.

[b]Fixed culling issues with oak trees[/b]

Sometimes, they would just [i]disappear[/i] at long distances, this is no longer the case.

[b]Did more animations for the revolver[/b]

An animation for the speedloader going into the revolver and an animation of the wheel spinning when the hammer is cocked back have been added.

[b]Changed some level 94 materials[/b]

Added some macro variation and better normals on the ground.

[b]Hid many objects inside of lootable drawers[/b]

Sneaky scavengers will revel in the fact that there are now hidden coins and money inside the drawers on level 5.

[b]Improved the BAR magazine's bullet mesh[/b]

Self explanatory.

Thanks for the read, and happy belated Easter. Bye!

notes.title: V. 2.51
notes.content:
Hello BrVR Family! Today we have a new rifle, some grenade-related adjustments, and more!

[b]Added a New weapon: M1 Garand[/b]

This new rifle, the M1 Garand, has a special grenade launcher to go along with it. You can attach it to the muzzle, attach a grenade and pull the pin. However, remember to pull the bolt afterward.

[b]Added firesalt crystals, a new mineable crafting material[/b]

You can drill into the walls of level 5's boiler room as they contain these new firesalt crystals, used to make explosives. They also glow a bit, providing a much-needed light source down there.

[b]Added two new grenades, mk2 and flashbang[/b]

The Mk2 is a frag grenade with a large radius and a loud noise. The flashbang allows you to stun entities, but can also blind you for a couple of seconds.

[b]Added a "Boom Box"[/b]

In arena mode, there was no way to get grenades. Now there is, with the boom box. Once the game is started, press the button to get grenades. This isn't spammable though.

[b]Added some new crafting recipes[/b]

Ever wanted to craft up some high explosives? Well now you can, with the crafting table! You can craft firesalt grenades, flashbangs, and the Mk2 frag grenades now.

[b]Added crafting and mining equipment to the level 5 boiler room[/b]

You can craft back there to your heart's content. Mine with new firesalt and steel deposits, plus a drill to mine with.

[b]The headphones now play a custom song[/b]

Just replace the mp4 in your game's local files with an mp4 of your song. It will play inside of the headphones in the frontrooms.

[b]Adjusted the arena mode graphics[/b]

Color correction, need I say more?

[b]Boards now despawn faster (from 20 to 2.5 seconds)[/b]

This should make navigating some levels like RUN much easier, as the pesky boards won't be getting in your way the entire time.

[b]Did some significant optimization to level RUN, including fixing several moveable light issues and installing more traps[/b]

Lag while speedrunning is NO FUN, so I've gone ahead and made several notable changes. There are more traps to reduce the count of unneeded entities, and the lamps are less taxing on your GPU

[b]Did some other optimizations[/b]

Pretty minor stuff, mainly to level 5 and its many areas. Also reduced the cost of lamps here.

[b]Fixed a visual issue with the crafting table[/b]

the texture would display incorrectly on the output pad, this is fixed now.

[b]Fixed a crash with level 9 old 2[/b]

This level should be free to travel to, [strike]without any travel restrictions by the MEG government[/strike]

[b]Fixed lots of bugs[/b]

Skin cube subtitles are gone, fixed a strange building in level 1020 and more. Also, jittering and stalling of the hands and body should be mostly fixed.

[b]Made several adjustments to the level 7 beta[/b]

Added physical swimming, like in other water levels, and the scuba thrusters work again!

BTW the best way you can support the game is to leave a good review! Leave us your thoughts, it helps a ton to us at no price to you ːsteamthumbsupː

- Added a new section to the end of level Run
- Added many decorations to level 974 and adjusted the lighting
- Added many details to level Run-Dash-Run
- The tutorial has been organized and updated (WIP, the tutorial may receive many changes in the future)
- Added the Rage Rooms: A fun way to get out stress
- Added Sandbox Entity Capsules for some entities that didn't have them previously
- You can't spam-fire the G28 anymore
- Added some audio to scarabacks
- Added many new clip-o-matic preview images (more to come)
- The hands as present in the menu are more high quality
- Fixed many issues with reloading and generally streamlined the process of reloading
- Fixed issues with the shells of the G28
- Improved the balloon gun with new audio, better mass, better attachment, more balloon colors, better scaling, and the automatic deletion of "ghost balloons" when an entity dies
- The entities in the tutorial will respawn now
- You can now brew pyroil with almond water (hint: put it in your flamethrower or squirt gun)
- You can now see the shells physically inside the shotgun when you use the charging handle
- Decreased the size of the hitbox for the black goop in level 3
- Made some lighting adjustments in level 2
- For any weapons that don't already have this, the mags will now show up as empty correctly, with bullets in them if they're full and no bullets if they're empty

Hope you enjoy the update! Have fun as always.

notes.title: V. 2.26
notes.content:
Hello. Just got a major menu bug fixed!

- Fixed the menu cutting out/glitching entirely
- Added custom radio audio, just go to the gear icon in steam, browse local files -> BrVR117 -> Content -> Movies and replace TestVideo.mp4 with another video containing the audio you want to play. Note that volumes are slightly broken currently, it might come in super loud or silent.
- Made various improvements to the frontrooms, including adding a window
- Fixed an issue with attachments
- Fixed an issue with the AK-47
- Fixed an issue with the level 62 deer shooting minigame
- Fixed some environment gaps in level 33
- Fixed a fairly funny typo: I called the .357 a ".347" in the tutorial
- The Sandbox gun palette + cursor is improved
- Added some more area to level 188
- If you light the tip of an axe on fire it will now turn into a flaming axe that sets entities ablaze
- Lighting is rebuilt on level 20 making transitions between differently-lit sections of the map better

That's all. The menu bug was affecting level 0 so I wanted to fix it as soon as I could. Have a fun time being the best shot in the backrooms!

notes.title: V. 2.19
notes.content:
Sorry for the delays but I've been working on a complete overhaul of the enemy AI recently. It'll be gradually rolled out and this will be the first step. A ton of firearm-related changes, so have fun shooting up some entities!

- Added a new entity: Deer, animals that you can hunt on level 62 (there's a sniper rifle in the closet)
- Revamped level 62
- Added a new entity: Facelings with guns. They'll shoot at you if you shoot at them.
- Added a new entity: Skin-stealers with swords. Like the facelings, they won't attack unless provoked
- Added sandbox cylinders: A collectable that will unlock items in sandbox mode
- New models for the laser sight (it's now a red dot) and the suppressor which can go on any firearm now (except the AK-74, I forgor that one)
- You can now hold the 1911 with two hands
- Improved the audio and magazine of the G28
- You can now quickly reload any firearm be waving the new mag close to the one in the gun (the AK is special because it has an ejection button you hit with the mag)
- Level 2 is greatly expanded and the lighting looks much better
- Added a back-alley to level 5 that leads to the suites and has a dining room and storage area
- Added a new room to level 3 because why not?
- The flashlight is a bit dimmer and the light is in more of a "circle" shape now
- Added [i]next test[/i], a place to try out new AI mechanics
- Added even more blu lober, you people can't get enough of that!
- The ammo counter for the revolver is on the side of the gun now
- New particle effects for firesalt grenades
- The shotgun charging lever is animated now
- You can't eject shells from a revolver using the button anymore. Use the ejector rod instead
- You can shoot yourself now (epic feature)
- New music in the tutorial

Hope you enjoy the new update, have fun out there and don't forget to marinate your skin-stealer meat before you eat it! Bye.

notes.title: Version 2.0!
notes.content:
Version 2.0 is out! We're releasing on steam today, so an update was in order. Here's the new features:

- The sh4dy gr3y has been revamped, including more entities and a new sublevel: Th3 3nd

- Grab pulls and inventory sounds have been worked on, making the game feel faster and more satisfying

- There are 18 new achievements

- Skin or no skin has instructions now

- There's a light to illuminate the pile of flashlights in the boiler room on level 17

- A glitch has been fixed with the radio decrementing your sanity

- There are timers at the end of level run and level run dash run

- In adition, level run dash run has been expanded

- Clump power incorperated on level 1 dark has been reworked

- An annoying table on level 5 has been moved

- The large fire can light pyroil molotov cocktails

- The mangled's death is improved

- You can't grab the smiler in the sandbox anymore due to issues it causes with hand scale

- Axe and knife combat has been improved

- You can store Sh4dy Gr3y clocks and pyroil molotov cocktail cloths in your inventory now

- The range of deathmoths has been decreased

- Crafting recipes are present near some crafting tables

- The radio now says how to change the channel

- There is a new level added to the entities minigame in level fun

- Level 5's jumpscares are more hidden now

- There is a new winning screen on the terror hotel casino slots

- Flamethrowers now carry 20 fire streams instead of 40

- Added ambience to some levels

- Some more general improvements and bug fixes
